sql:
WITH customer_totals AS (
    SELECT customer_id, ROUND(STDDEV(shipping_fee), 2) AS stddev_shipping_fee, COUNT(amount) AS amount_count
    FROM orders
    GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT
    customers.credit_limit,
    customers.email,
    customer_totals.stddev_shipping_fee,
    customer_totals.amount_count
FROM customers
INNER JOIN customer_totals ON customers.id = customer_totals.customer_id
ORDER BY 3 DESC;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

customer_totals = (
    df_orders
    .groupBy("customer_id")
    .agg(
        F.round(F.stddev("shipping_fee"), 2).alias("stddev_shipping_fee"),
        F.count("amount").alias("amount_count"),
    )
)

result = (
    df_customers.alias("customers")
    .join(customer_totals.alias("customer_totals"), F.col("customers.id") == F.col("customer_totals.customer_id"), "inner")
    .select(
        F.col("customers.credit_limit"),
        F.col("customers.email"),
        F.col("customer_totals.stddev_shipping_fee"),
        F.col("customer_totals.amount_count"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("stddev_shipping_fee").desc())
)

sql:
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT
        is_active,
        CASE WHEN YEAR(signup_date) < 2024 THEN 'before_2024' WHEN YEAR(signup_date) = 2024 THEN '2024' ELSE 'after_2024' END AS signup_cohort,
        MIN(credit_limit) AS min_credit_limit,
        SUM(credit_limit) AS total_credit_limit
    FROM customers
    WHERE email IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY is_active, CASE WHEN YEAR(signup_date) < 2024 THEN 'before_2024' WHEN YEAR(signup_date) = 2024 THEN '2024' ELSE 'after_2024' END
) AS agg
WHERE min_credit_limit >= 14400
ORDER BY min_credit_limit DESC;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_customers
    .filter(F.col("email").isNotNull())
    .groupBy(
        "is_active",
        F.when(F.year("signup_date") < 2024, "before_2024").when(F.year("signup_date") == 2024, "2024").otherwise("after_2024").alias("signup_cohort"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.min("credit_limit").alias("min_credit_limit"),
        F.sum("credit_limit").alias("total_credit_limit"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("min_credit_limit") >= 14400)
    .orderBy(F.col("min_credit_limit").desc())
)

WITH recent_subscriptions AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM subscriptions
    WHERE plan IN ('premium', 'enterprise', 'basic')
),
Agg AS (
    SELECT CASE WHEN plan IN ('enterprise', 'premium') THEN 'priority' ELSE 'other' END plan_group, SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(plan)) plan_list, SUM(monthly_fee) total_monthly_fee

sql: with RecentPayments as (select *, concat(method, ' ', status) as method_status from payments where not ((status in ('SUCCESS', 'REFUNDED', 'FAILED') and status in ('FAILED', 'REFUNDED')) or amount <= 1120)), payments_stats as (select year(paid_at) as paid_year, method, max(amount) - min(amount) as amount_range, min(paid_at) as first_paid_at from RecentPayments group by year(paid_at), method) select paid_year, method, amount_range, first_paid_at from payments_stats where amount_range > 42
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

recent_payments = (
    df_payments
    .filter(~((F.col("status").isin(["SUCCESS", "REFUNDED", "FAILED"]) & F.col("status").isin(["FAILED", "REFUNDED"])) | (F.col("amount") <= 1120)))
    .withColumn("method_status", F.concat("method", F.lit(" "), "status"))
)

payments_stats = (
    recent_payments
    .groupBy(F.year("paid_at").alias("paid_year"), "method")
    .agg(
        (F.max("amount") - F.min("amount")).alias("amount_range"),
        F.min("paid_at").alias("first_paid_at"),
    )
)

result = (
    payments_stats
    .filter(F.col("amount_range") > 42)
    .select("paid_year", "method", "amount_range", "first_paid_at")
)

sql:
WITH valid_departments AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM departments
    WHERE budget IS NOT NULL
),
departments_stats AS (
    SELECT CASE WHEN budget >= 3847000 THEN 'high' WHEN budget >= 1360000 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS budget_bucket, SUM(budget) AS total_budget, ROUND(AVG(budget), 2) AS avg_budget
    FROM valid_departments
    GROUP BY CASE WHEN budget >= 3847000 THEN 'high' WHEN budget >= 1360000 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END
)
SELECT budget_bucket, total_budget, avg_budget
FROM departments_stats
WHERE avg_budget >= 40
ORDER BY budget_bucket, avg_budget DESC
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

valid_departments = df_departments.filter(F.col("budget").isNotNull())

departments_stats = (
    valid_departments
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("budget") >= 3847000, "high").when(F.col("budget") >= 1360000, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("budget_bucket"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.sum("budget").alias("total_budget"),
        F.round(F.avg("budget"), 2).alias("avg_budget"),
    )
)

result = (
    departments_stats
    .filter(F.col("avg_budget") >= 40)
    .select("budget_bucket", "total_budget", "avg_budget")
    .orderBy("budget_bucket", F.col("avg_budget").desc())
)

        F.when(F.col("quantity") >= 8, "high").when(F.col("quantity") >= 2, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("quantity_bucket"),
        "product_id",
    )
    .agg(
        F.sum("quantity").alias("total_quantity"),
        F.avg("quantity").alias("avg_quantity"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("total_quantity") < 30)
    .select("quantity_bucket", "product_id", "total_quantity", "avg_quantity")
    .orderBy(F.col("product_id").desc())
)

sql: SELECT c.is_active, CASE WHEN c.age >= 56 THEN 'high' WHEN c.age >= 34 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS age_bucket, SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'RETURNED' THEN o.shipping_fee ELSE 0 END) AS returned_shipping_fee, SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'CANCELLED' THEN o.shipping_fee ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled_shipping_fee FROM orders o INNER JOIN stores s ON o.store_id = s.id LEFT JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE s.city IN ('Berlin', 'London') GROUP BY c.is_active, CASE WHEN c.age >= 56 THEN 'high' WHEN c.age >= 34 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_orders.alias("o")
    .join(df_stores.alias("s"), F.col("o.store_id") == F.col("s.id"), "inner")
    .join(df_customers.alias("c"), F.col("o.customer_id") == F.col("c.id"), "left")
    .filter(F.col("s.city").isin(["Berlin", "London"]))
    .groupBy(
        F.col("c.is_active"),
        F.when(F.col("c.age") >= 56, "high").when(F.col("c.age") >= 34, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("age_bucket"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("o.status") == "RETURNED", F.col("o.shipping_fee")).otherwise(0)).alias("returned_shipping_fee"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("o.status") == "CANCELLED", F.col("o.shipping_fee")).otherwise(0)).alias("cancelled_shipping_fee"),
    )
)

sql:
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN YEAR(end_date) < 2024 THEN 'before_2024' WHEN YEAR(end_date) = 2024 THEN '2024' ELSE 'after_2024' END AS end_cohort,
        customer_id,
        ROUND((100 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'EXPIRED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_expired,
        MAX(monthly_fee) AS max_monthly_fee
    FROM subscriptions
    GROUP BY CASE WHEN YEAR(end_date) < 2024 THEN 'before_2024' WHEN YEAR(end_date) = 2024 THEN '2024' ELSE 'after_2024' END, customer_id
) AS sub
WHERE max_monthly_fee < 90
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_subscriptions
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.year("end_date") < 2024, "before_2024").when(F.year("end_date") == 2024, "2024").otherwise("after_2024").alias("end_cohort"),
        "customer_id",
    )
    .agg(
        F.round(((100 * F.sum(F.when(F.col("status") == "EXPIRED", 1).otherwise(0))) / F.count("*")), 1).alias("pct_expired"),
        F.max("monthly_fee").alias("max_monthly_fee"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("max_monthly_fee") < 90)
)

sql: with base as (select * from stores where region in ('South', 'Central', 'East') and opened_date > '2025-06-01' and store_name is not null), Agg as (select case when year(opened_date) < 2024 then 'before_2024' when year(opened_date) = 2024 then '2024' else 'after_2024' end as opened_cohort, round(stddev(sqft), 2) as stddev_sqft from base group by case when year(opened_date) < 2024 then 'before_2024' when year(opened_date) = 2024 then '2024' else 'after_2024' end) select * from Agg where stddev_sqft > 37 order by stddev_sqft, opened_cohort limit 3;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

base = (
    df_stores
    .filter(F.col("region").isin(["South", "Central", "East"]) & (F.col("opened_date") > "2025-06-01") & F.col("store_name").isNotNull())
)

agg = (
    base
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.year("opened_date") < 2024, "before_2024").when(F.year("opened_date") == 2024, "2024").otherwise("after_2024").alias("opened_cohort"),
    )
    .agg(F.round(F.stddev("sqft"), 2).alias("stddev_sqft"))
)

result = (
    agg
    .filter(F.col("stddev_sqft") > 37)
    .orderBy("stddev_sqft", "opened_cohort")

WHERE e.dept_id IN (16, 27)
GROUP BY CASE WHEN d.budget >= 3554000 THEN 'high' WHEN d.budget >= 1516000 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END, CASE WHEN d.location IN ('Bangkok', 'Chiang Mai') THEN 'tier_1' ELSE 'other' END

from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_orders
    .groupBy(
        "status",
        F.when(F.col("shipping_fee") >= 40, "high").when(F.col("shipping_fee") >= 9, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("shipping_fee_bucket"),
        F.when(F.col("status").isin(["SHIPPED", "COMPLETED"]), "group_a").otherwise("other").alias("status_group"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("status") == "RETURNED", 1).otherwise(0)).alias("returned_count"),
    )
)

sql:
WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        merchant,
        txn_time,
        is_flagged,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY merchant ORDER BY txn_time, id) AS rnk
    FROM transactions
)
SELECT
    id,
    merchant,
    txn_time,
    is_flagged
FROM ranked
WHERE rnk = 1
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("merchant").orderBy("txn_time", "id")

result = (
    df_transactions
    .select(
        "id",
        "merchant",
        "txn_time",
        "is_flagged",
        F.row_number().over(w).alias("rnk"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("rnk") == 1)
    .select("id", "merchant", "txn_time", "is_flagged")
)

sql: SELECT CASE WHEN YEAR(paid_at) < 2024 THEN 'before_2024' WHEN YEAR(paid_at) = 2024 THEN '2024' ELSE 'after_2024' END AS paid_cohort, ROUND(AVG(amount), 2) AS avg_amount FROM payments GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*) < 3;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_payments
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.year("paid_at") < 2024, "before_2024").when(F.year("paid_at") == 2024, "2024").otherwise("after_2024").alias("paid_cohort"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.round(F.avg("amount"), 2).alias("avg_amount"),
        F.count("*").alias("num_payments"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("num_payments") < 3)
    .drop("num_payments")
)

SELECT
    id,
    product_id,
    last_restock,
    store_id,
    quantity,
    NTILE(10) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY last_restock DESC, id) AS last_restock_ntile,

        "product_id",
        "last_restock",
        "store_id",

sql: select year(signup_date) as signup_year, sum(age) as total_age, round(sum(age) * 100.0 / sum(sum(age)) over (), 2) as pct_of_total from customers group by year(signup_date) order by signup_year desc

        F.col("s.sqft"),

    FROM products

)

sql:
select
    case when c.city in ('Bangkok', 'Tokyo') then 'group_a' else 'other' end as city_group,
    c.country,
    max(a.balance) - min(a.balance) as balance_range,
    max(a.opened_date) as last_opened_date
from accounts a
join customers c on a.customer_id = c.id
where c.name like '%Cha%'
group by case when c.city in ('Bangkok', 'Tokyo') then 'group_a' else 'other' end, c.country
order by city_group desc, country asc
limit 20;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_accounts.alias("a")
    .join(df_customers.alias("c"), F.col("a.customer_id") == F.col("c.id"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("c.name").like("%Cha%"))
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("c.city").isin(["Bangkok", "Tokyo"]), "group_a").otherwise("other").alias("city_group"),
        F.col("c.country"),
    )
    .agg(
        (F.max(F.col("a.balance")) - F.min(F.col("a.balance"))).alias("balance_range"),
        F.max(F.col("a.opened_date")).alias("last_opened_date"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("city_group").desc(), "country")
    .limit(20)
)

sql:
SELECT CASE WHEN a.status IN ('CLOSED', 'FROZEN') THEN 'tier_1' ELSE 'other' END AS status_group, CASE WHEN a.balance >= 79000 THEN 'high' WHEN a.balance >= 7000 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS balance_bucket, SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(t.txn_type)) AS txn_type_list
FROM transactions t
INNER JOIN accounts a ON a.id = t.account_id
GROUP BY CASE WHEN a.status IN ('CLOSED', 'FROZEN') THEN 'tier_1' ELSE 'other' END, CASE WHEN a.balance >= 79000 THEN 'high' WHEN a.balance >= 7000 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END
ORDER BY 1 DESC;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_transactions.alias("t")
    .join(df_accounts.alias("a"), F.col("a.id") == F.col("t.account_id"), "inner")
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("a.status").isin(["CLOSED", "FROZEN"]), "tier_1").otherwise("other").alias("status_group"),
        F.when(F.col("a.balance") >= 79000, "high").when(F.col("a.balance") >= 7000, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("balance_bucket"),
    )
    .agg(F.sort_array(F.collect_set(F.col("t.txn_type"))).alias("txn_type_list"))
    .orderBy(F.col("status_group").desc())
)

sql:
WITH src AS (
    SELECT *, DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), end_date) AS days_since_end_date
    FROM subscriptions
    WHERE customer_id IN (27, 37, 38)
),
subscriptions_stats AS (
    SELECT
        status,
        DATE_FORMAT(end_date, 'yyyy-MM') AS end_month,
        SUM(CASE WHEN plan = 'standard' THEN days_since_end_date ELSE 0 END) AS standard_days_since_end_date,
        MAX(start_date) AS last_start_date
    FROM src
    GROUP BY status, DATE_FORMAT(end_date, 'yyyy-MM')
)
SELECT *
FROM subscriptions_stats
ORDER BY standard_days_since_end_date DESC
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

src = (
    df_subscriptions
    .filter(F.col("customer_id").isin([27, 37, 38]))
    .withColumn("days_since_end_date", F.datediff(F.current_date(), "end_date"))
)

subscriptions_stats = (
    src
    .groupBy("status", F.date_format("end_date", "yyyy-MM").alias("end_month"))
    .agg(
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("plan") == "standard", F.col("days_since_end_date")).otherwise(0)).alias("standard_days_since_end_date"),
        F.max("start_date").alias("last_start_date"),
    )
)

result = subscriptions_stats.orderBy(F.col("standard_days_since_end_date").desc())

sql:
SELECT products.brand, SUM(order_items.quantity * order_items.unit_price) AS revenue, ROUND(STDDEV(order_items.quantity), 2) AS stddev_quantity
FROM order_items
INNER JOIN orders ON order_items.order_id = orders.id
FULL OUTER JOIN products ON order_items.product_id = products.id
GROUP BY products.brand
HAVING ROUND(STDDEV(order_items.quantity), 2) > 67
ORDER BY revenue, products.brand DESC
LIMIT 10;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_order_items.alias("order_items")
    .join(df_orders.alias("orders"), F.col("order_items.order_id") == F.col("orders.id"), "inner")
    .join(df_products.alias("products"), F.col("order_items.product_id") == F.col("products.id"), "outer")
    .groupBy(F.col("products.brand"))
    .agg(
        F.sum((F.col("order_items.quantity") * F.col("order_items.unit_price"))).alias("revenue"),
        F.round(F.stddev(F.col("order_items.quantity")), 2).alias("stddev_quantity"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("stddev_quantity") > 67)
    .orderBy("revenue", F.col("brand").desc())
    .limit(10)
)

sql:
select case when o.discount >= 0.41 then 'high' when o.discount >= 0.11 then 'mid' else 'low' end as discount_bucket, round(stddev(oi.quantity), 2) as stddev_quantity, count(oi.quantity) as quantity_count
from order_items oi
left join orders o on oi.order_id = o.id
where o.channel in ('web', 'mobile')
group by case when o.discount >= 0.41 then 'high' when o.discount >= 0.11 then 'mid' else 'low' end
order by discount_bucket, quantity_count desc
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

)

sql:
SELECT
    CASE WHEN YEAR(last_restock) < 2024 THEN 'before_2024' WHEN YEAR(last_restock) = 2024 THEN '2024' ELSE 'after_2024' END AS last_restock_cohort,
    CASE WHEN quantity >= 261 THEN 'high' WHEN quantity >= 119 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS quantity_bucket,
    MAX(quantity) - MIN(quantity) AS quantity_range,
    ROUND(AVG(quantity), 2) AS avg_quantity,
    COUNT(DISTINCT quantity) AS unique_stores
FROM inventory
GROUP BY last_restock_cohort, quantity_bucket
HAVING MAX(quantity) - MIN(quantity) >= 47
ORDER BY quantity_bucket;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

    df_inventory
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.year("last_restock") < 2024, "before_2024").when(F.year("last_restock") == 2024, "2024").otherwise("after_2024").alias("last_restock_cohort"),
        F.when(F.col("quantity") >= 261, "high").when(F.col("quantity") >= 119, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("quantity_bucket"),
    )
    .agg(
        (F.max("quantity") - F.min("quantity")).alias("quantity_range"),
        F.round(F.avg("quantity"), 2).alias("avg_quantity"),
        F.countDistinct("quantity").alias("unique_stores"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("quantity_range") >= 47)
    .orderBy("quantity_bucket")
)

sql: SELECT CASE WHEN monthly_fee >= 239 THEN 'high' WHEN monthly_fee >= 103 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS monthly_fee_bucket, COUNT(*) AS cnt, ROUND((100 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'EXPIRED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_expired, COUNT(DISTINCT monthly_fee) AS unique_plans FROM subscriptions WHERE customer_id IN (19, 31, 38) GROUP BY 1

SELECT

        city,

sql: WITH base AS (SELECT * FROM stores WHERE (store_name LIKE '%Old%' AND city IN ('London', 'Bangkok')) OR MONTH(opened_date) IN (6, 8, 9)), stores_stats AS (SELECT city, SUM(CASE WHEN city = 'Berlin' THEN sqft ELSE 0 END) AS berlin_sqft, MAX(sqft) - MIN(sqft) AS sqft_range FROM base GROUP BY city) SELECT city, berlin_sqft, sqft_range FROM stores_stats WHERE berlin_sqft > 37 ORDER BY city DESC LIMIT 5;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

base = (
    df_stores
    .filter((F.col("store_name").like("%Old%") & F.col("city").isin(["London", "Bangkok"])) | F.month("opened_date").isin([6, 8, 9]))
)

stores_stats = (
    base
    .groupBy("city")
    .agg(
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("city") == "Berlin", F.col("sqft")).otherwise(0)).alias("berlin_sqft"),
        (F.max("sqft") - F.min("sqft")).alias("sqft_range"),
    )
)

result = (
    stores_stats
    .filter(F.col("berlin_sqft") > 37)
    .select("city", "berlin_sqft", "sqft_range")
    .orderBy(F.col("city").desc())
    .limit(5)
)

WITH recent_transactions AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM transactions
    WHERE merchant IN ('Shell', 'Grab') AND amount < 2500
),
Summary AS (
    SELECT CASE WHEN YEAR(txn_time) < 2024 THEN 'before_2024' WHEN YEAR(txn_time) = 2024 THEN '2024' ELSE 'after_2024' END AS txn_cohort, SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(merchant)) AS merchant_list, MAX(amount) - MIN(amount) AS amount_range
    FROM recent_transactions
    GROUP BY CASE WHEN YEAR(txn_time) < 2024 THEN 'before_2024' WHEN YEAR(txn_time) = 2024 THEN '2024' ELSE 'after_2024' END
)
SELECT txn_cohort, merchant_list, amount_range
FROM Summary
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

    df_transactions
    .filter(F.col("merchant").isin(["Shell", "Grab"]) & (F.col("amount") < 2500))

    recent_transactions
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.year("txn_time") < 2024, "before_2024").when(F.year("txn_time") == 2024, "2024").otherwise("after_2024").alias("txn_cohort"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("merchant")).alias("merchant_list"),

)

        F.when(F.col("monthly_fee") >= 230, "high").when(F.col("monthly_fee") >= 62, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("monthly_fee_bucket"),

group by c.segment, c.country
order by pct_premium desc, segment, country
limit 1

    .orderBy(F.col("pct_premium").desc(), "segment", "country")
    .limit(1)
)

WITH src AS (

with base as (
    select *
    from products
    where brand is null and supplier_id = 32
),
launch_cohort_summary as (
    select case when year(launch_date) < 2024 then 'before_2024' when year(launch_date) = 2024 then '2024' else 'after_2024' end launch_cohort, concat_ws(', ', sort_array(collect_set(brand))) brand_values
    from base
    group by case when year(launch_date) < 2024 then 'before_2024' when year(launch_date) = 2024 then '2024' else 'after_2024' end

    .agg(F.concat_ws(", ", F.sort_array(F.collect_set("brand"))).alias("brand_values"))

    .select("launch_cohort", "brand_values")

SELECT discount_bucket, avg_shipping_fee, shipped_discount
FROM (
    SELECT CASE WHEN discount >= 0.44 THEN 'high' WHEN discount >= 0.17 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END discount_bucket, AVG(shipping_fee) avg_shipping_fee, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SHIPPED' THEN discount ELSE 0 END) shipped_discount
    FROM orders
    WHERE store_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY CASE WHEN discount >= 0.44 THEN 'high' WHEN discount >= 0.17 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END
) t
WHERE shipped_discount < 41
ORDER BY shipped_discount ASC;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

    df_orders
    .filter(F.col("store_id").isNull())
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("discount") >= 0.44, "high").when(F.col("discount") >= 0.17, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("discount_bucket"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.avg("shipping_fee").alias("avg_shipping_fee"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("status") == "SHIPPED", F.col("discount")).otherwise(0)).alias("shipped_discount"),
    )

WITH base AS (
    SELECT *, COALESCE(amount, 0) AS amount_filled
    FROM payments
    WHERE method = 'bank_transfer'
),
paid_month_summary AS (
    SELECT DATE_FORMAT(paid_at, 'yyyy-MM') AS paid_month, MAX(amount_filled) - MIN(amount_filled) AS amount_filled_range, MIN(amount) AS min_amount
    FROM base
    GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(paid_at, 'yyyy-MM')
)
SELECT *
FROM paid_month_summary
WHERE min_amount >= 510
ORDER BY amount_filled_range DESC;

from pyspark.sql import functions as F

    df_payments
    .filter(F.col("method") == "bank_transfer")

)

    base
    .groupBy(F.date_format("paid_at", "yyyy-MM").alias("paid_month"))
    .agg(
        (F.max("amount_filled") - F.min("amount_filled")).alias("amount_filled_range"),
        F.min("amount").alias("min_amount"),
    )
)

result = (
    paid_month_summary
    .filter(F.col("min_amount") >= 510)
    .orderBy(F.col("amount_filled_range").desc())
)

WITH filtered_web_events AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM web_events
    WHERE event_time >= '2024-06-01' AND duration_sec > 233
),
event_month_summary AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', event_time) AS event_month,
        CASE WHEN duration_sec >= 402 THEN 'high' WHEN duration_sec >= 225 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS duration_sec_bucket,
        ROUND((100 * SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'add_to_cart' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_add_to_cart,
        SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(event_type)) AS event_type_list
    FROM filtered_web_events
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', event_time), CASE WHEN duration_sec >= 402 THEN 'high' WHEN duration_sec >= 225 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END
)
SELECT *
FROM event_month_summary
ORDER BY pct_add_to_cart DESC, duration_sec_bucket, event_month
LIMIT 20;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

filtered_web_events = (
    df_web_events
    .filter((F.col("event_time") >= "2024-06-01") & (F.col("duration_sec") > 233))
)

event_month_summary = (
    filtered_web_events
    .groupBy(
        F.date_trunc("MONTH", "event_time").alias("event_month"),
        F.when(F.col("duration_sec") >= 402, "high").when(F.col("duration_sec") >= 225, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("duration_sec_bucket"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.round(((100 * F.sum(F.when(F.col("event_type") == "add_to_cart", 1).otherwise(0))) / F.count("*")), 1).alias("pct_add_to_cart"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("event_type")).alias("event_type_list"),
    )
)

result = (
    event_month_summary
    .orderBy(F.col("pct_add_to_cart").desc(), "duration_sec_bucket", "event_month")
    .limit(20)
)

where country = 'TH'
group by 1
having sum(case when city = 'Tokyo' then age else 0 end) > 62
order by unique_countrys, country
limit 20;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_customers
    .filter(F.col("country") == "TH")
    .groupBy("country")
    .agg(
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("city") == "Tokyo", F.col("age")).otherwise(0)).alias("tokyo_age"),
        F.countDistinct("credit_limit").alias("unique_countrys"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("tokyo_age") > 62)
    .orderBy("unique_countrys", "country")
    .limit(20)
)

sql: WITH src AS (SELECT * FROM orders WHERE store_id IN (17, 37) OR store_id IS NULL), status_group_summary AS (SELECT CASE WHEN status IN ('PENDING', 'COMPLETED') THEN 'tier_1' ELSE 'other' END AS status_group, SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(status)) AS status_list, ROUND((100 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_completed FROM src GROUP BY CASE WHEN status IN ('PENDING', 'COMPLETED') THEN 'tier_1' ELSE 'other' END) SELECT status_group, status_list, pct_completed FROM status_group_summary;

sql:
WITH filtered_store_sales AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE NOT (units <= 16 AND (units <= 39 OR MONTH(sale_date) IN (3, 5, 11)))
),
agg AS (
    SELECT product_id, SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue, MIN(sale_date) AS first_sale_date
    FROM filtered_store_sales
    GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT *
FROM agg
WHERE total_revenue < 18000
ORDER BY product_id
LIMIT 1
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

filtered_store_sales = (
    df_store_sales
    .filter(~((F.col("units") <= 16) & ((F.col("units") <= 39) | F.month("sale_date").isin([3, 5, 11]))))
)

agg = (
    filtered_store_sales
    .groupBy("product_id")
    .agg(
        F.sum("revenue").alias("total_revenue"),
        F.min("sale_date").alias("first_sale_date"),
    )
)

result = (
    agg
    .filter(F.col("total_revenue") < 18000)
    .orderBy("product_id")
    .limit(1)
)

sql:
with valid_suppliers as (
    select *
    from suppliers
    where city in ('Tokyo', 'New York') and supplier_name like '%Glo%'
),
suppliers_stats as (
    select country, case when rating >= 4.4 then 'high' when rating >= 1.6 then 'mid' else 'low' end as rating_bucket, count(distinct rating) as unique_countrys
    from valid_suppliers
    group by country, case when rating >= 4.4 then 'high' when rating >= 1.6 then 'mid' else 'low' end
)
select country, rating_bucket
from suppliers_stats
order by rating_bucket
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

valid_suppliers = (
    df_suppliers
    .filter(F.col("city").isin(["Tokyo", "New York"]) & F.col("supplier_name").like("%Glo%"))
)

suppliers_stats = (
    valid_suppliers
    .groupBy(
        "country",
        F.when(F.col("rating") >= 4.4, "high").when(F.col("rating") >= 1.6, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("rating_bucket"),
    )
    .agg(F.countDistinct("rating").alias("unique_countrys"))
)

sql:
with src as (
    select *, trim(plan) as clean_plan
    from subscriptions
    where plan = 'basic'
),
agg as (
    select case when monthly_fee >= 260 then 'high' when monthly_fee >= 89 then 'mid' else 'low' end as monthly_fee_bucket, count(case when status = 'CANCELLED' then 1 end) as cancelled_count, round(avg(monthly_fee), 2) as avg_monthly_fee
    from src
    group by case when monthly_fee >= 260 then 'high' when monthly_fee >= 89 then 'mid' else 'low' end
)
select monthly_fee_bucket, cancelled_count, avg_monthly_fee
from agg
where avg_monthly_fee >= 60
order by cancelled_count, monthly_fee_bucket
limit 3;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

src = (
    df_subscriptions
    .filter(F.col("plan") == "basic")
    .withColumn("clean_plan", F.trim("plan"))
)

agg = (
    src
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("monthly_fee") >= 260, "high").when(F.col("monthly_fee") >= 89, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("monthly_fee_bucket"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("status") == "CANCELLED", 1)).alias("cancelled_count"),
        F.round(F.avg("monthly_fee"), 2).alias("avg_monthly_fee"),
    )
)

result = (
    agg
    .filter(F.col("avg_monthly_fee") >= 60)
    .select("monthly_fee_bucket", "cancelled_count", "avg_monthly_fee")
    .orderBy("cancelled_count", "monthly_fee_bucket")
    .limit(3)
)

    FROM web_events

),

    SELECT page, MIN(duration_sec) AS min_duration_sec, MAX(duration_sec) - MIN(duration_sec) AS duration_sec_range

sql:
SELECT
    CASE WHEN YEAR(sale_date) < 2024 THEN 'before_2024' WHEN YEAR(sale_date) = 2024 THEN '2024' ELSE 'after_2024' END AS sale_cohort,
    SUM(units) AS total_units,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt,
    SUM(SUM(units)) OVER (ORDER BY CASE WHEN YEAR(sale_date) < 2024 THEN 'before_2024' WHEN YEAR(sale_date) = 2024 THEN '2024' ELSE 'after_2024' END) AS cumulative_units
FROM store_sales
GROUP BY CASE WHEN YEAR(sale_date) < 2024 THEN 'before_2024' WHEN YEAR(sale_date) = 2024 THEN '2024' ELSE 'after_2024' END
ORDER BY sale_cohort DESC, cnt DESC;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.orderBy("sale_cohort")

result = (
    df_store_sales
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.year("sale_date") < 2024, "before_2024").when(F.year("sale_date") == 2024, "2024").otherwise("after_2024").alias("sale_cohort"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.sum("units").alias("total_units"),
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
    )
    .withColumn("cumulative_units", F.sum("total_units").over(w))
    .orderBy(F.col("sale_cohort").desc(), F.col("cnt").desc())
)

with EmployeesByDepartment as (
    select dept_id, sum(case when level = 'L1' then 1 else 0 end) as l1_count, count(case when level = 'L3' then 1 end) as l3_count
    from employees
    where full_name like 'bob%'
    group by dept_id
)

    .orderBy("location")
)

    FROM inventory
    WHERE store_id IN (1, 2, 3) OR store_id IN (2, 4, 6)
),
Agg AS (
    SELECT CASE WHEN YEAR(last_restock_period) < 2024 THEN 'before_2024' WHEN YEAR(last_restock_period) = 2024 THEN '2024' ELSE 'after_2024' END AS last_restock_period_cohort, COUNT(DISTINCT quantity) AS unique_products
    FROM filtered_inventory
    GROUP BY CASE WHEN YEAR(last_restock_period) < 2024 THEN 'before_2024' WHEN YEAR(last_restock_period) = 2024 THEN '2024' ELSE 'after_2024' END

sql: SELECT ss.product_id, QUARTER(ss.sale_date) AS sale_quarter, ROUND(STDDEV(i.quantity), 2) AS stddev_quantity, MIN(i.quantity) AS min_quantity FROM inventory i INNER JOIN store_sales ss ON i.store_id = ss.store_id AND i.product_id = ss.product_id WHERE ss.units != 19 GROUP BY ss.product_id, QUARTER(ss.sale_date) HAVING min_quantity >= 100 ORDER BY stddev_quantity DESC, ss.product_id DESC, sale_quarter LIMIT 1;

sql:
SELECT
    MONTH(a.opened_date) AS opened_month,
    CASE WHEN YEAR(a.opened_date) < 2024 THEN 'before_2024' WHEN YEAR(a.opened_date) = 2024 THEN '2024' ELSE 'after_2024' END AS opened_cohort,
    COUNT(t.amount) AS amount_count,
    COUNT(*) AS total_count
FROM transactions t
JOIN accounts a ON t.account_id = a.id
WHERE a.account_type IN ('LOAN', 'SAVINGS', 'CHECKING')
GROUP BY MONTH(a.opened_date), CASE WHEN YEAR(a.opened_date) < 2024 THEN 'before_2024' WHEN YEAR(a.opened_date) = 2024 THEN '2024' ELSE 'after_2024' END
ORDER BY amount_count DESC
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_transactions.alias("t")
    .join(df_accounts.alias("a"), F.col("t.account_id") == F.col("a.id"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("a.account_type").isin(["LOAN", "SAVINGS", "CHECKING"]))
    .groupBy(
        F.month(F.col("a.opened_date")).alias("opened_month"),
        F.when(F.year(F.col("a.opened_date")) < 2024, "before_2024").when(F.year(F.col("a.opened_date")) == 2024, "2024").otherwise("after_2024").alias("opened_cohort"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count(F.col("t.amount")).alias("amount_count"),
        F.count("*").alias("total_count"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("amount_count").desc())
)

sql:
SELECT
    event_type,
    CASE WHEN duration_sec >= 403 THEN 'high' WHEN duration_sec >= 202 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS duration_sec_bucket,
    ROUND(STDDEV(duration_sec), 2) AS stddev_duration_sec,
    SUM(duration_sec) AS total_duration_sec
FROM web_events
GROUP BY 1, 2
HAVING stddev_duration_sec >= 59
code:

        F.sum("duration_sec").alias("total_duration_sec"),

    .filter(F.col("stddev_duration_sec") >= 59)
)

    AVG(units) AS avg_units,
    COUNT(units) AS units_count

    a.status,
    MAX(t.amount) AS max_amount,
    ROUND(AVG(t.amount), 2) AS avg_amount
FROM transactions t

        is_remote,

sql:
WITH filtered_order_items AS (
    SELECT *, CAST(quantity AS DOUBLE) AS quantity_str
    FROM order_items
    WHERE product_id IN (2, 4, 35)
),
summary AS (
    SELECT CASE WHEN unit_price >= 390 THEN 'high' WHEN unit_price >= 140 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS unit_price_bucket, MIN(quantity) AS min_quantity, ROUND(AVG(unit_price), 2) AS avg_unit_price
    FROM filtered_order_items
    GROUP BY CASE WHEN unit_price >= 390 THEN 'high' WHEN unit_price >= 140 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END
)
SELECT unit_price_bucket, min_quantity, avg_unit_price
FROM summary
WHERE min_quantity > 2.8
ORDER BY unit_price_bucket
LIMIT 50;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

filtered_order_items = (
    df_order_items
    .filter(F.col("product_id").isin([2, 4, 35]))
    .withColumn("quantity_str", F.col("quantity").cast("double"))
)

summary = (
    filtered_order_items
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("unit_price") >= 390, "high").when(F.col("unit_price") >= 140, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("unit_price_bucket"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.min("quantity").alias("min_quantity"),
        F.round(F.avg("unit_price"), 2).alias("avg_unit_price"),
    )
)

result = (
    summary
    .filter(F.col("min_quantity") > 2.8)
    .select("unit_price_bucket", "min_quantity", "avg_unit_price")
    .orderBy("unit_price_bucket")
    .limit(50)
)

SELECT
    CASE WHEN departments.budget >= 3352000 THEN 'high' WHEN departments.budget >= 779000 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS budget_bucket,
    CASE WHEN departments.dept_name IN ('Marketing', 'Engineering') THEN 'priority' ELSE 'other' END AS dept_name_group,
    MIN(employees.salary) AS min_salary,
    MAX(employees.salary) - MIN(employees.salary) AS salary_range
FROM employees
RIGHT JOIN departments ON departments.id = employees.dept_id
WHERE departments.budget BETWEEN 3465000 AND 3626000
GROUP BY CASE WHEN departments.budget >= 3352000 THEN 'high' WHEN departments.budget >= 779000 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END, CASE WHEN departments.dept_name IN ('Marketing', 'Engineering') THEN 'priority' ELSE 'other' END

FROM order_items oi
INNER JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id

GROUP BY CASE WHEN o.discount >= 0.38 THEN 'high' WHEN o.discount >= 0.16 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END

    s.country,
    st.product_count,
    st.unique_categorys
FROM suppliers s
LEFT OUTER JOIN supplier_totals st ON s.id = st.supplier_id
WHERE st.unique_categorys > 8
ORDER BY s.id DESC;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

supplier_totals = (
    df_products
    .filter(F.col("price").between(500, 1040))
    .groupBy("supplier_id")
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("product_count"),
        F.countDistinct("stock_qty").alias("unique_categorys"),
    )
)

result = (
    df_suppliers.alias("s")
    .join(supplier_totals.alias("st"), F.col("s.id") == F.col("st.supplier_id"), "left")
    .filter(F.col("st.unique_categorys") > 8)
    .select(
        F.col("s.id"),
        F.col("s.country"),
        F.col("st.product_count"),
        F.col("st.unique_categorys"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("id").desc())
)

SELECT

    ROUND(STDDEV(ss.revenue), 2) AS stddev_revenue

sql:
SELECT CASE WHEN o.amount >= 1530 THEN 'high' WHEN o.amount >= 600 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS amount_bucket, ROUND(AVG(oi.unit_price), 2) AS avg_unit_price
FROM order_items oi
RIGHT JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
WHERE oi.product_id IN (7, 8)
GROUP BY CASE WHEN o.amount >= 1530 THEN 'high' WHEN o.amount >= 600 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END
HAVING avg_unit_price >= 50
ORDER BY avg_unit_price DESC
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_order_items.alias("oi")
    .join(df_orders.alias("o"), F.col("oi.order_id") == F.col("o.id"), "right")
    .filter(F.col("oi.product_id").isin([7, 8]))
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("o.amount") >= 1530, "high").when(F.col("o.amount") >= 600, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("amount_bucket"),
    )
    .agg(F.round(F.avg(F.col("oi.unit_price")), 2).alias("avg_unit_price"))
    .filter(F.col("avg_unit_price") >= 50)
    .orderBy(F.col("avg_unit_price").desc())
)

sql:
SELECT
    start_cohort,
    plan,
    expired_count,
    active_count
FROM (
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN YEAR(start_date) < 2024 THEN 'before_2024' WHEN YEAR(start_date) = 2024 THEN '2024' ELSE 'after_2024' END AS start_cohort,
        plan,
        SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'EXPIRED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS expired_count,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 END) AS active_count
    FROM subscriptions
    WHERE plan = 'premium'
    GROUP BY CASE WHEN YEAR(start_date) < 2024 THEN 'before_2024' WHEN YEAR(start_date) = 2024 THEN '2024' ELSE 'after_2024' END, plan
) AS t
WHERE active_count >= 6;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_subscriptions
    .filter(F.col("plan") == "premium")
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.year("start_date") < 2024, "before_2024").when(F.year("start_date") == 2024, "2024").otherwise("after_2024").alias("start_cohort"),
        "plan",
    )
    .agg(
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("status") == "EXPIRED", 1).otherwise(0)).alias("expired_count"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("status") == "ACTIVE", 1)).alias("active_count"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("active_count") >= 6)
    .select("start_cohort", "plan", "expired_count", "active_count")
)

FROM payments p

sql: WITH base AS (SELECT *, DAY(start_date) AS start_date_day FROM subscriptions WHERE (end_date > '2025-03-01' AND customer_id IS NULL) OR monthly_fee > 140), end_cohort_summary AS (SELECT CASE WHEN YEAR(end_date) < 2024 THEN 'before_2024' WHEN YEAR(end_date) = 2024 THEN '2024' ELSE 'after_2024' END AS end_cohort, customer_id, CONCAT_WS(', ', SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(status))) AS status_values FROM base GROUP BY CASE WHEN YEAR(end_date) < 2024 THEN 'before_2024' WHEN YEAR(end_date) = 2024 THEN '2024' ELSE 'after_2024' END, customer_id) SELECT end_cohort, customer_id FROM end_cohort_summary;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

base = (
    df_subscriptions
    .filter(((F.col("end_date") > "2025-03-01") & F.col("customer_id").isNull()) | (F.col("monthly_fee") > 140))
    .withColumn("start_date_day", F.dayofmonth("start_date"))
)

end_cohort_summary = (
    base
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.year("end_date") < 2024, "before_2024").when(F.year("end_date") == 2024, "2024").otherwise("after_2024").alias("end_cohort"),
        "customer_id",
    )
    .agg(
        F.concat_ws(", ", F.sort_array(F.collect_set("status"))).alias("status_values"),
    )
)

result = end_cohort_summary.select("end_cohort", "customer_id")

sql: WITH filtered_store_sales AS (SELECT *, revenue * units AS revenue_per_unit FROM store_sales WHERE product_id = 3), Summary AS (SELECT QUARTER(sale_date) AS sale_quarter, MIN(sale_date) AS first_sale_date, ROUND(AVG(revenue_per_unit), 2) AS avg_revenue_per_unit FROM filtered_store_sales GROUP BY QUARTER(sale_date)) SELECT sale_quarter, first_sale_date, avg_revenue_per_unit FROM Summary ORDER BY first_sale_date;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

    df_store_sales
    .filter(F.col("product_id") == 3)
    .withColumn("revenue_per_unit", (F.col("revenue") * F.col("units")))
)

summary = (
    filtered_store_sales
    .groupBy(F.quarter("sale_date").alias("sale_quarter"))
    .agg(
        F.min("sale_date").alias("first_sale_date"),

    )
)

    summary
    .select("sale_quarter", "first_sale_date", "avg_revenue_per_unit")
    .orderBy("first_sale_date")
)

sql: select budget_bucket, singapore_budget from (select case when budget >= 3953000 then 'high' when budget >= 1499000 then 'mid' else 'low' end as budget_bucket, sum(case when location = 'Singapore' then budget else 0 end) as singapore_budget from departments where budget < 1369000 group by case when budget >= 3953000 then 'high' when budget >= 1499000 then 'mid' else 'low' end) as x where singapore_budget >= 47;

    SELECT account_id, CONCAT_WS(', ', SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(merchant))) AS merchant_values, MAX(amount) AS max_amount
    FROM transactions
    WHERE merchant != 'Grab'
    GROUP BY account_id
)

)

sql:
WITH department_stats AS (
    SELECT dept_id, ROUND(AVG(salary), 2) avg_salary, ROUND((100 * SUM(CASE WHEN job_title = 'Intern' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) / COUNT(*), 1) pct_intern
    FROM employees
    WHERE job_title IN ('Director', 'Designer', 'Analyst')
    GROUP BY dept_id
)
SELECT
    departments.id,
    departments.location,
    departments.dept_name,
    department_stats.avg_salary,
    department_stats.pct_intern
FROM departments
INNER JOIN department_stats ON departments.id = department_stats.dept_id
WHERE department_stats.pct_intern > 55
ORDER BY location DESC, id
LIMIT 5;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

department_stats = (
    df_employees
    .filter(F.col("job_title").isin(["Director", "Designer", "Analyst"]))
    .groupBy("dept_id")
    .agg(
        F.round(F.avg("salary"), 2).alias("avg_salary"),
        F.round(((100 * F.sum(F.when(F.col("job_title") == "Intern", 1).otherwise(0))) / F.count("*")), 1).alias("pct_intern"),
    )
)

result = (
    df_departments.alias("departments")
    .join(department_stats.alias("department_stats"), F.col("departments.id") == F.col("department_stats.dept_id"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("department_stats.pct_intern") > 55)
    .select(
        F.col("departments.id"),
        F.col("departments.location"),
        F.col("departments.dept_name"),
        F.col("department_stats.avg_salary"),
        F.col("department_stats.pct_intern"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("location").desc(), "id")
    .limit(5)
)

sql:
SELECT
    end_cohort,
    customer_id,
    pct_cancelled,
    stddev_monthly_fee
FROM (
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN YEAR(end_date) < 2024 THEN 'before_2024' WHEN YEAR(end_date) = 2024 THEN '2024' ELSE 'after_2024' END AS end_cohort,
        customer_id,
        ROUND((100 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'CANCELLED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_cancelled,
        ROUND(STDDEV(monthly_fee), 2) AS stddev_monthly_fee
    FROM subscriptions
    WHERE YEAR(start_date) >= 2023
    GROUP BY CASE WHEN YEAR(end_date) < 2024 THEN 'before_2024' WHEN YEAR(end_date) = 2024 THEN '2024' ELSE 'after_2024' END, customer_id
) AS agg
WHERE pct_cancelled >= 55
ORDER BY stddev_monthly_fee DESC, end_cohort, customer_id
LIMIT 1;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_subscriptions
    .filter(F.year("start_date") >= 2023)
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.year("end_date") < 2024, "before_2024").when(F.year("end_date") == 2024, "2024").otherwise("after_2024").alias("end_cohort"),
        "customer_id",
    )
    .agg(
        F.round(((100 * F.sum(F.when(F.col("status") == "CANCELLED", 1).otherwise(0))) / F.count("*")), 1).alias("pct_cancelled"),
        F.round(F.stddev("monthly_fee"), 2).alias("stddev_monthly_fee"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("pct_cancelled") >= 55)
    .select("end_cohort", "customer_id", "pct_cancelled", "stddev_monthly_fee")

)

WITH order_stats AS (
    SELECT order_id, ROUND((100 * SUM(CASE WHEN carrier = 'Flash' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_flash, CONCAT_WS(', ', SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(carrier))) AS carrier_values
    FROM shipments
    GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT
    orders.amount,
    orders.order_date,
    order_stats.pct_flash,
    order_stats.carrier_values

        F.concat_ws(", ", F.sort_array(F.collect_set("carrier"))).alias("carrier_values"),
    )
)

result = (
    df_orders.alias("orders")
    .join(order_stats.alias("order_stats"), F.col("orders.id") == F.col("order_stats.order_id"), "inner")

    .select(

        F.col("orders.order_date"),
        F.col("order_stats.pct_flash"),

)

    FROM customers

sql:
with supplier_summary as (
    select supplier_id, max(price) - min(price) as price_range, sum(case when category = 'Sports' then 1 else 0 end) as sports_count
    from products
    where category != 'Home'
    group by supplier_id
)
select
    s.id,
    s.rating,
    s.country,
    ss.price_range,
    ss.sports_count
from suppliers s
inner join supplier_summary ss on s.id = ss.supplier_id
where ss.price_range > 79
order by 4 desc, id
limit 10;

    df_products
    .filter(F.col("category") != "Home")

        F.sum(F.when(F.col("category") == "Sports", 1).otherwise(0)).alias("sports_count"),
    )
)

    df_suppliers.alias("s")
    .join(supplier_summary.alias("ss"), F.col("s.id") == F.col("ss.supplier_id"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("ss.price_range") > 79)
    .select(
        F.col("s.id"),
        F.col("s.rating"),
        F.col("s.country"),
        F.col("ss.price_range"),
        F.col("ss.sports_count"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("price_range").desc(), "id")
    .limit(10)
)

sql:
SELECT
    CASE WHEN rating >= 4.2 THEN 'high' WHEN rating >= 1.6 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS rating_bucket,
    SUM(rating) AS total_rating,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt,
    ROUND(SUM(rating) * 100.0 / SUM(SUM(rating)) OVER (), 2) AS pct_of_total
FROM suppliers
GROUP BY CASE WHEN rating >= 4.2 THEN 'high' WHEN rating >= 1.6 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END
ORDER BY pct_of_total, rating_bucket
LIMIT 1;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy()

result = (
    df_suppliers
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("rating") >= 4.2, "high").when(F.col("rating") >= 1.6, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("rating_bucket"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.sum("rating").alias("total_rating"),
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
    )
    .withColumn("pct_of_total", F.round(((F.col("total_rating") * 100) / F.sum("total_rating").over(w)), 2))
    .orderBy("pct_of_total", "rating_bucket")
    .limit(1)
)

WITH base AS (

    FROM orders
    WHERE amount >= 1570 OR status IN ('RETURNED', 'SHIPPED', 'COMPLETED')
),
order_month_summary AS (

)

)

order_month_summary = (
    base
    .groupBy(F.month("order_date").alias("order_month"))
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("total_count"),

)

WITH valid_payments AS (
    SELECT *, SUBSTRING(method, 1, 4) AS method_prefix
    FROM payments
    WHERE method IN ('card', 'bank_transfer')
),
method_summary AS (
    SELECT
        method,
        TO_DATE(paid_at) AS paid_day,
        AVG(amount) AS avg_amount,
        MAX(amount) - MIN(amount) AS amount_range
    FROM valid_payments
    GROUP BY method, TO_DATE(paid_at)
)
SELECT
    method,
    paid_day,
    avg_amount,
    amount_range
FROM method_summary
ORDER BY amount_range, method, paid_day
LIMIT 5;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

valid_payments = (
    df_payments
    .filter(F.col("method").isin(["card", "bank_transfer"]))
    .withColumn("method_prefix", F.substring("method", 1, 4))
)

method_summary = (
    valid_payments
    .groupBy("method", F.to_date("paid_at").alias("paid_day"))
    .agg(
        F.avg("amount").alias("avg_amount"),
        (F.max("amount") - F.min("amount")).alias("amount_range"),
    )
)

result = (
    method_summary
    .select("method", "paid_day", "avg_amount", "amount_range")
    .orderBy("amount_range", "method", "paid_day")
    .limit(5)
)

sql:
SELECT
    p.product_name,
    p.supplier_id,
    t.cnt,
    t.stddev_unit_price
FROM products p
JOIN (SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt, ROUND(STDDEV(unit_price), 2) AS stddev_unit_price
    FROM order_items
    GROUP BY product_id) t ON p.id = t.product_id
WHERE t.stddev_unit_price >= 33
ORDER BY t.cnt
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

order_items_by_product = (
    df_order_items
    .groupBy("product_id")
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
        F.round(F.stddev("unit_price"), 2).alias("stddev_unit_price"),
    )
)

result = (
    df_products.alias("p")
    .join(order_items_by_product.alias("t"), F.col("p.id") == F.col("t.product_id"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("t.stddev_unit_price") >= 33)
    .select(
        F.col("p.product_name"),
        F.col("p.supplier_id"),
        F.col("t.cnt"),
        F.col("t.stddev_unit_price"),
    )
    .orderBy("cnt")
)

sql: SELECT id, txn_time, amount, account_id, ROUND(AVG(amount) OVER (ORDER BY txn_time, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS amount_moving_avg_4, LEAD(amount, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY txn_time, id) AS next_amount FROM transactions WHERE is_flagged ORDER BY account_id;
code:

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

SELECT unit_price_bucket, unit_price_range, unique_products
FROM (
    SELECT CASE WHEN unit_price >= 350 THEN 'high' WHEN unit_price >= 110 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS unit_price_bucket, MAX(unit_price) - MIN(unit_price) AS unit_price_range, COUNT(DISTINCT unit_price) AS unique_products
    FROM order_items
    WHERE product_id IN (2, 29, 34)
    GROUP BY CASE WHEN unit_price >= 350 THEN 'high' WHEN unit_price >= 110 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END
) AS x

    .agg(
        (F.max("unit_price") - F.min("unit_price")).alias("unit_price_range"),
        F.countDistinct("unit_price").alias("unique_products"),

WITH filtered_employees AS (

    FROM employees
    WHERE salary < 143000 AND salary < 74000
),
hire_month_summary AS (
    SELECT
        MONTH(hire_date) AS hire_month,
        manager_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT salary) AS unique_levels,

sql:
WITH base AS (
    SELECT *, TRIM(status) AS clean_status
    FROM accounts
    WHERE balance > 43000 AND status IN ('CLOSED', 'FROZEN', 'OPEN') AND opened_date < '2025-02-01'
),
accounts_stats AS (
    SELECT status, CASE WHEN balance >= 59000 THEN 'high' WHEN balance >= 29000 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS balance_bucket, AVG(balance) AS avg_balance
    FROM base
    GROUP BY status, CASE WHEN balance >= 59000 THEN 'high' WHEN balance >= 29000 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END
)
SELECT status, balance_bucket, avg_balance
FROM accounts_stats
WHERE avg_balance < 18000
ORDER BY status DESC;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

base = (
    df_accounts
    .filter((F.col("balance") > 43000) & F.col("status").isin(["CLOSED", "FROZEN", "OPEN"]) & (F.col("opened_date") < "2025-02-01"))
    .withColumn("clean_status", F.trim("status"))
)

accounts_stats = (
    base
    .groupBy(
        "status",
        F.when(F.col("balance") >= 59000, "high").when(F.col("balance") >= 29000, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("balance_bucket"),
    )
    .agg(F.avg("balance").alias("avg_balance"))
)

result = (
    accounts_stats
    .filter(F.col("avg_balance") < 18000)
    .select("status", "balance_bucket", "avg_balance")
    .orderBy(F.col("status").desc())
)

sql:
select method, concat_ws(', ', sort_array(collect_set(method))) method_values
from payments
where status in ('SUCCESS', 'FAILED', 'REFUNDED') and order_id is not null
group by method
having count(case when status = 'FAILED' then 1 end) > 1
order by method_values, method
limit 3;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_payments
    .filter(F.col("status").isin(["SUCCESS", "FAILED", "REFUNDED"]) & F.col("order_id").isNotNull())
    .groupBy("method")
    .agg(
        F.concat_ws(", ", F.sort_array(F.collect_set("method"))).alias("method_values"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("status") == "FAILED", 1)).alias("failed_count"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("failed_count") > 1)
    .drop("failed_count")
    .orderBy("method_values", "method")
    .limit(3)
)

WITH ValidOrders AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM orders
    WHERE NOT (discount >= 0.25 AND shipping_fee < 22 AND channel <> 'store')
),
Agg AS (
    SELECT channel, ROUND(STDDEV(amount), 2) AS stddev_amount
    FROM ValidOrders
    GROUP BY channel
)
SELECT channel, stddev_amount
FROM Agg
WHERE stddev_amount > 60
ORDER BY 2;

    .filter(~((F.col("discount") >= 0.25) & (F.col("shipping_fee") < 22) & (F.col("channel") != "store")))

    valid_orders
    .groupBy("channel")
    .agg(F.round(F.stddev("amount"), 2).alias("stddev_amount"))
)

result = (
    agg
    .filter(F.col("stddev_amount") > 60)
    .select("channel", "stddev_amount")
    .orderBy("stddev_amount")
)

SELECT CASE WHEN YEAR(ss.sale_date) < 2024 THEN 'before_2024' WHEN YEAR(ss.sale_date) = 2024 THEN '2024' ELSE 'after_2024' END sale_cohort, AVG(i.quantity) avg_quantity
FROM inventory i
INNER JOIN store_sales ss ON i.store_id = ss.store_id AND i.product_id = ss.product_id

sql: WITH base AS (SELECT *, ROUND(quantity * 1.07, 2) AS quantity_scaled FROM order_items WHERE quantity = 6), agg AS (SELECT product_id, MAX(quantity_scaled) - MIN(quantity_scaled) AS quantity_scaled_range, SUM(unit_price) AS total_unit_price FROM base GROUP BY product_id) SELECT * FROM agg WHERE total_unit_price >= 1000 ORDER BY product_id DESC;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

base = (
    df_order_items
    .filter(F.col("quantity") == 6)
    .withColumn("quantity_scaled", F.round((F.col("quantity") * 1.07), 2))
)

agg = (
    base
    .groupBy("product_id")
    .agg(
        (F.max("quantity_scaled") - F.min("quantity_scaled")).alias("quantity_scaled_range"),
        F.sum("unit_price").alias("total_unit_price"),
    )
)

result = (
    agg
    .filter(F.col("total_unit_price") >= 1000)
    .orderBy(F.col("product_id").desc())
)

select
    job_title,
    case when job_title in ('Engineer', 'Analyst') then 'core' else 'other' end job_title_group,
    min(salary) min_salary,
    count(case when level = 'L5' then 1 end) l5_count,

from employees

with src as (
    select *, trim(country) as clean_country
    from suppliers
    where not (lower(trim(supplier_name)) = 'global supply' and supplier_name like 'Tok%')
),
agg as (
    select case when rating >= 4.0 then 'high' when rating >= 2.5 then 'mid' else 'low' end as rating_bucket, country, round(avg(rating), 2) as avg_rating
    from src
    group by case when rating >= 4.0 then 'high' when rating >= 2.5 then 'mid' else 'low' end, country
)
select rating_bucket, avg_rating
from agg
order by rating_bucket

from pyspark.sql import functions as F

    df_suppliers
    .filter(~((F.lower(F.trim("supplier_name")) == "global supply") & F.col("supplier_name").like("Tok%")))
    .withColumn("clean_country", F.trim("country"))
)

agg = (
    src
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("rating") >= 4.0, "high").when(F.col("rating") >= 2.5, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("rating_bucket"),
        "country",
    )
    .agg(F.round(F.avg("rating"), 2).alias("avg_rating"))

)

WITH ValidShipments AS (

    FROM shipments
    WHERE (order_id IS NOT NULL AND MONTH(shipped_date) IN (1, 7, 9)) OR order_id = 13

    .agg((F.max("cost") - F.min("cost")).alias("cost_range"))

    .select("status", "cost_range")
    .orderBy("status", F.col("cost_range").desc())
)

sql: WITH base AS (SELECT *, CEIL(unit_price) AS unit_price_whole FROM order_items WHERE (product_id IN (5, 15, 37) AND quantity BETWEEN 3 AND 6) OR order_id = 8), order_items_stats AS (SELECT CASE WHEN unit_price >= 340 THEN 'high' WHEN unit_price >= 100 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS unit_price_bucket, CASE WHEN unit_price_whole >= 71 THEN 'high' WHEN unit_price_whole >= 17 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS unit_price_whole_bucket, MAX(unit_price_whole) - MIN(unit_price_whole) AS unit_price_whole_range FROM base GROUP BY CASE WHEN unit_price >= 340 THEN 'high' WHEN unit_price >= 100 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END, CASE WHEN unit_price_whole >= 71 THEN 'high' WHEN unit_price_whole >= 17 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END) SELECT unit_price_bucket, unit_price_whole_bucket, unit_price_whole_range FROM order_items_stats ORDER BY unit_price_bucket;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

base = (
    df_order_items
    .filter((F.col("product_id").isin([5, 15, 37]) & F.col("quantity").between(3, 6)) | (F.col("order_id") == 8))
    .withColumn("unit_price_whole", F.ceil("unit_price"))
)

order_items_stats = (
    base
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("unit_price") >= 340, "high").when(F.col("unit_price") >= 100, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("unit_price_bucket"),
        F.when(F.col("unit_price_whole") >= 71, "high").when(F.col("unit_price_whole") >= 17, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("unit_price_whole_bucket"),
    )
    .agg(
        (F.max("unit_price_whole") - F.min("unit_price_whole")).alias("unit_price_whole_range"),
    )
)

result = (
    order_items_stats
    .select("unit_price_bucket", "unit_price_whole_bucket", "unit_price_whole_range")
    .orderBy("unit_price_bucket")
)

sql: WITH RecentTransactions AS (SELECT *, TO_DATE(txn_time) AS txn_time_date FROM transactions WHERE is_flagged OR is_flagged = TRUE), summary AS (SELECT CASE WHEN amount >= 3800 THEN 'high' WHEN amount >= 1700 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS amount_bucket, YEAR(txn_time_date) AS txn_year, ROUND(AVG(amount), 2) AS avg_amount FROM RecentTransactions GROUP BY CASE WHEN amount >= 3800 THEN 'high' WHEN amount >= 1700 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END, YEAR(txn_time_date)) SELECT amount_bucket, txn_year, avg_amount FROM summary WHERE avg_amount >= 49

sql:
with src as (
    select *
    from stores
    where city = 'New York' and opened_date > '2024-11-01'
),
agg as (
    select region, round((100 * sum(case when city = 'London' then 1 else 0 end)) / count(*), 1) as pct_london, sum(case when region = 'East' then 1 else 0 end) as east_count
    from src
    group by region
)
select region, pct_london, east_count
from agg
where east_count > 67

    .filter((F.col("city") == "New York") & (F.col("opened_date") > "2024-11-01"))
)

    .groupBy("region")
    .agg(
        F.round(((100 * F.sum(F.when(F.col("city") == "London", 1).otherwise(0))) / F.count("*")), 1).alias("pct_london"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("region") == "East", 1).otherwise(0)).alias("east_count"),
    )
)

result = (

    .filter(F.col("east_count") > 67)

    .orderBy(F.col("region").desc())
)

SELECT
    a.id,
    a.balance,
    a.status,
    t.shell_count,
    t.amount_count
FROM accounts a
JOIN (SELECT account_id, SUM(CASE WHEN merchant = 'Shell' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS shell_count, COUNT(amount) AS amount_count
    FROM transactions
    WHERE txn_type = 'REFUND'
    GROUP BY account_id) t ON a.id = t.account_id

    df_transactions
    .filter(F.col("txn_type") == "REFUND")
    .groupBy("account_id")
    .agg(
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("merchant") == "Shell", 1).otherwise(0)).alias("shell_count"),
        F.count("amount").alias("amount_count"),
    )
)

result = (
    df_accounts.alias("a")
    .join(account_totals.alias("t"), F.col("a.id") == F.col("t.account_id"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("t.amount_count") >= 9)
    .select(
        F.col("a.id"),
        F.col("a.balance"),
        F.col("a.status"),
        F.col("t.shell_count"),
        F.col("t.amount_count"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("amount_count").desc())
)

sql:
WITH base AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM payments
    WHERE amount >= 1460 AND (amount > 1420 OR status = 'REFUNDED')
),
summary AS (
    SELECT status, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 END) AS failed_count, SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(method)) AS method_list
    FROM base
    GROUP BY status
)
SELECT status, failed_count, method_list
FROM summary
WHERE failed_count >= 9
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

base = (
    df_payments
    .filter((F.col("amount") >= 1460) & ((F.col("amount") > 1420) | (F.col("status") == "REFUNDED")))
)

summary = (
    base
    .groupBy("status")
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("status") == "FAILED", 1)).alias("failed_count"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("method")).alias("method_list"),
    )
)

result = (
    summary
    .filter(F.col("failed_count") >= 9)
    .select("status", "failed_count", "method_list")
)

sql: SELECT o.channel, o.status, ROUND(AVG(oi.unit_price), 2) AS avg_unit_price FROM order_items oi FULL OUTER JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE oi.unit_price < 360 GROUP BY o.channel, o.status HAVING ROUND(AVG(oi.unit_price), 2) > 42 ORDER BY status, channel LIMIT 5;
code:

    df_order_items.alias("oi")
    .join(df_orders.alias("o"), F.col("oi.order_id") == F.col("o.id"), "outer")

select
    status,
    round(stddev(monthly_fee), 2) as stddev_monthly_fee,
    sum(case when plan = 'standard' then monthly_fee else 0 end) as standard_monthly_fee,
    max(monthly_fee) - min(monthly_fee) as monthly_fee_range
from subscriptions
where status != 'PAUSED' or monthly_fee >= 180
group by status
order by monthly_fee_range desc;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

    df_subscriptions

    .groupBy("status")
    .agg(

        F.sum(F.when(F.col("plan") == "standard", F.col("monthly_fee")).otherwise(0)).alias("standard_monthly_fee"),

sql:
WITH account_stats AS (
    SELECT account_id, CONCAT_WS(', ', SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(merchant))) AS merchant_values
    FROM transactions
    WHERE txn_type <> 'FEE'
    GROUP BY account_id
)
SELECT
    a.id,
    a.balance,
    a.status,
    as.merchant_values
FROM accounts a
LEFT JOIN account_stats as ON a.id = as.account_id
ORDER BY balance

    df_transactions
    .filter(F.col("txn_type") != "FEE")
    .groupBy("account_id")

        F.concat_ws(", ", F.sort_array(F.collect_set("merchant"))).alias("merchant_values"),
    )
)

result = (
    df_accounts.alias("a")
    .join(account_stats.alias("as"), F.col("a.id") == F.col("as.account_id"), "left")
    .select(
        F.col("a.id"),
        F.col("a.balance"),
        F.col("a.status"),
        F.col("as.merchant_values"),
    )
    .orderBy("balance")
)

sql:
WITH src AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM departments
    WHERE budget > 2011000 AND dept_name != 'Marketing' AND dept_name != 'Marketing'
),
departments_stats AS (
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN budget >= 3835000 THEN 'high' WHEN budget >= 827000 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS budget_bucket,
        dept_name,
        AVG(budget) AS avg_budget,
        CONCAT_WS(', ', SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(dept_name))) AS dept_name_values
    FROM src
    GROUP BY CASE WHEN budget >= 3835000 THEN 'high' WHEN budget >= 827000 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END, dept_name
)
SELECT
    budget_bucket,
    dept_name,
    avg_budget,
    dept_name_values
FROM departments_stats
WHERE avg_budget < 2720000
ORDER BY dept_name_values, avg_budget DESC
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

src = (
    df_departments
    .filter((F.col("budget") > 2011000) & (F.col("dept_name") != "Marketing") & (F.col("dept_name") != "Marketing"))
)

departments_stats = (
    src
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("budget") >= 3835000, "high").when(F.col("budget") >= 827000, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("budget_bucket"),
        "dept_name",
    )
    .agg(
        F.avg("budget").alias("avg_budget"),
        F.concat_ws(", ", F.sort_array(F.collect_set("dept_name"))).alias("dept_name_values"),
    )
)

result = (
    departments_stats
    .filter(F.col("avg_budget") < 2720000)
    .select("budget_bucket", "dept_name", "avg_budget", "dept_name_values")
    .orderBy("dept_name_values", F.col("avg_budget").desc())
)

sql: WITH valid_products AS (SELECT * FROM products WHERE brand = 'Stark'), products_stats AS (SELECT CASE WHEN YEAR(launch_date) < 2024 THEN 'before_2024' WHEN YEAR(launch_date) = 2024 THEN '2024' ELSE 'after_2024' END launch_cohort, MIN(launch_date) min_launch_date FROM valid_products GROUP BY CASE WHEN YEAR(launch_date) < 2024 THEN 'before_2024' WHEN YEAR(launch_date) = 2024 THEN '2024' ELSE 'after_2024' END) SELECT launch_cohort, min_launch_date FROM products_stats ORDER BY min_launch_date DESC, launch_cohort
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

valid_products = df_products.filter(F.col("brand") == "Stark")

products_stats = (
    valid_products
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.year("launch_date") < 2024, "before_2024").when(F.year("launch_date") == 2024, "2024").otherwise("after_2024").alias("launch_cohort"),
    )
    .agg(F.min("launch_date").alias("min_launch_date"))
)

result = (
    products_stats
    .select("launch_cohort", "min_launch_date")
    .orderBy(F.col("min_launch_date").desc(), "launch_cohort")
)

sql:
select month(o.order_date) order_month, count(s.cost) cost_count, sum(s.cost) total_cost
from shipments s
left join orders o on o.id = s.order_id
where s.carrier not in ('Kerry', 'DHL')
group by month(o.order_date)
having sum(s.cost) > 250

)

    SELECT *, CONCAT_WS('-', city, supplier_name) AS city_supplier_name_key

code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

    df_suppliers
    .filter(F.col("country") == "JP")

select
    case when o.channel in ('mobile', 'store') then 'group_a' else 'other' end as channel_group,
    o.channel,
    max(p.amount) - min(p.amount) as amount_range,
    sort_array(collect_set(p.method)) as method_list
from payments p
inner join orders o on o.id = p.order_id
group by case when o.channel in ('mobile', 'store') then 'group_a' else 'other' end, o.channel

limit 5

sql:
WITH base AS (
    SELECT *, ADD_MONTHS(opened_date, 6) AS opened_date_plus_months
    FROM stores
    WHERE LENGTH(store_name) < 9
),
Agg AS (
    SELECT CASE WHEN region IN ('North', 'South') THEN 'core' ELSE 'other' END AS region_group, ROUND(AVG(sqft), 2) AS avg_sqft, COUNT(CASE WHEN city = 'Bangkok' THEN 1 END) AS bangkok_count
    FROM base
    GROUP BY CASE WHEN region IN ('North', 'South') THEN 'core' ELSE 'other' END
)
SELECT region_group, avg_sqft, bangkok_count
FROM Agg
ORDER BY 2;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

base = (
    df_stores
    .filter(F.length("store_name") < 9)
    .withColumn("opened_date_plus_months", F.add_months("opened_date", 6))
)

agg = (
    base
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("region").isin(["North", "South"]), "core").otherwise("other").alias("region_group"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.round(F.avg("sqft"), 2).alias("avg_sqft"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("city") == "Bangkok", 1)).alias("bangkok_count"),
    )
)

result = (
    agg
    .select("region_group", "avg_sqft", "bangkok_count")
    .orderBy("avg_sqft")
)

sql:
select
    case when amount >= 1330 then 'high' when amount >= 440 then 'mid' else 'low' end as amount_bucket,
    sum(amount) as total_amount,
    count(*) as cnt,
    sum(sum(amount)) over (order by case when amount >= 1330 then 'high' when amount >= 440 then 'mid' else 'low' end) as cumulative_amount
from payments
where paid_at >= '2023-10-01'
group by case when amount >= 1330 then 'high' when amount >= 440 then 'mid' else 'low' end
order by total_amount desc, cumulative_amount
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.orderBy("amount_bucket")

result = (
    df_payments
    .filter(F.col("paid_at") >= "2023-10-01")
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("amount") >= 1330, "high").when(F.col("amount") >= 440, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("amount_bucket"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.sum("amount").alias("total_amount"),
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
    )
    .withColumn("cumulative_amount", F.sum("total_amount").over(w))
    .orderBy(F.col("total_amount").desc(), "cumulative_amount")
)

select quarter(s.opened_date) opened_quarter, max(p.paid_at) last_paid_at, max(p.amount) max_amount
from payments p
join orders o on p.order_id = o.id
join stores s on o.store_id = s.id
group by quarter(s.opened_date)
order by opened_quarter desc, max_amount desc
limit 3;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_payments.alias("p")
    .join(df_orders.alias("o"), F.col("p.order_id") == F.col("o.id"), "inner")
    .join(df_stores.alias("s"), F.col("o.store_id") == F.col("s.id"), "inner")
    .groupBy(F.quarter(F.col("s.opened_date")).alias("opened_quarter"))
    .agg(
        F.max(F.col("p.paid_at")).alias("last_paid_at"),
        F.max(F.col("p.amount")).alias("max_amount"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("opened_quarter").desc(), F.col("max_amount").desc())

    GROUP BY account_id) t ON a.id = t.account_id
WHERE t.lazada_amount > 69
ORDER BY id DESC
LIMIT 1;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

    df_transactions
    .groupBy("account_id")
    .agg(
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("txn_type") == "CREDIT", F.col("amount")).otherwise(0)).alias("credit_amount"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("merchant") == "Lazada", F.col("amount")).otherwise(0)).alias("lazada_amount"),
    )
)

result = (
    df_accounts.alias("a")
    .join(account_totals.alias("t"), F.col("a.id") == F.col("t.account_id"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("t.lazada_amount") > 69)
    .select(
        F.col("a.id"),
        F.col("a.customer_id"),
        F.col("t.credit_amount"),
        F.col("t.lazada_amount"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("id").desc())
    .limit(1)
)

select *
from (
    select
        case when year(delivered_date) < 2024 then 'before_2024' when year(delivered_date) = 2024 then '2024' else 'after_2024' end as delivered_cohort,
        year(delivered_date) as delivered_year,
        count(case when carrier = 'Kerry' then 1 end) as kerry_count,

    from shipments

sql: SELECT CASE WHEN amount >= 4000 THEN 'high' WHEN amount >= 1400 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS amount_bucket, txn_type, MAX(amount) - MIN(amount) AS amount_range, MIN(amount) AS min_amount FROM transactions WHERE txn_type <> 'DEBIT' GROUP BY CASE WHEN amount >= 4000 THEN 'high' WHEN amount >= 1400 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END, txn_type ORDER BY amount_range DESC;

    FROM web_events
    WHERE page IN ('/home', '/cart', '/search') AND event_type IN ('click', 'purchase')
),
web_events_stats AS (
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN event_type IN ('purchase', 'add_to_cart') THEN 'group_a' ELSE 'other' END AS event_type_group,
        page,
        SUM(CASE WHEN page = '/home' THEN duration_sec ELSE 0 END) AS home_duration_sec,
        MAX(event_time) AS latest_event_time
    FROM src
    GROUP BY CASE WHEN event_type IN ('purchase', 'add_to_cart') THEN 'group_a' ELSE 'other' END, page

    WHERE status = 'EXPIRED' AND plan NOT IN ('premium', 'basic')

SELECT CASE WHEN stores.city IN ('London', 'Berlin') THEN 'tier_1' ELSE 'other' END AS city_group, MIN(inventory.last_restock) AS first_last_restock, MAX(inventory.quantity) - MIN(inventory.quantity) AS quantity_range
FROM inventory
LEFT JOIN stores ON inventory.store_id = stores.id
INNER JOIN products ON inventory.product_id = products.id
WHERE YEAR(inventory.last_restock) >= 2023
GROUP BY CASE WHEN stores.city IN ('London', 'Berlin') THEN 'tier_1' ELSE 'other' END
ORDER BY quantity_range DESC, first_last_restock
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_inventory.alias("inventory")
    .join(df_stores.alias("stores"), F.col("inventory.store_id") == F.col("stores.id"), "left")
    .join(df_products.alias("products"), F.col("inventory.product_id") == F.col("products.id"), "inner")
    .filter(F.year(F.col("inventory.last_restock")) >= 2023)
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("stores.city").isin(["London", "Berlin"]), "tier_1").otherwise("other").alias("city_group"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.min(F.col("inventory.last_restock")).alias("first_last_restock"),
        (F.max(F.col("inventory.quantity")) - F.min(F.col("inventory.quantity"))).alias("quantity_range"),
    )

)

with recent_departments as (
    select *, case when location = 'London' then 1 else 0 end is_london
    from departments
    where location in ('New York', 'Bangkok', 'London')
),
summary as (
    select case when dept_name in ('Finance', 'HR') then 'group_a' else 'other' end dept_name_group, concat_ws(', ', sort_array(collect_set(dept_name))) dept_name_values
    from recent_departments
    group by case when dept_name in ('Finance', 'HR') then 'group_a' else 'other' end

WITH Base AS (

    FROM transactions
    WHERE account_id IN (1, 31)
),

    SELECT is_flagged, MAX(amount) AS max_amount, ROUND((100 * SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'FEE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_fee

)

sql: SELECT status, CASE WHEN monthly_fee >= 244 THEN 'high' WHEN monthly_fee >= 114 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS monthly_fee_bucket, SUM(CASE WHEN plan = 'enterprise' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS enterprise_count, CONCAT_WS(', ', SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(status))) AS status_values, MIN(start_date) AS min_start_date FROM subscriptions WHERE end_date >= '2024-08-01' AND status NOT IN ('EXPIRED', 'CANCELLED') AND end_date <= '2025-05-01' GROUP BY status, CASE WHEN monthly_fee >= 244 THEN 'high' WHEN monthly_fee >= 114 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN plan = 'enterprise' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 33 ORDER BY 1 DESC, min_start_date;

        F.when(F.col("monthly_fee") >= 244, "high").when(F.col("monthly_fee") >= 114, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("monthly_fee_bucket"),

    df_suppliers
    .filter(F.col("supplier_name").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("rating_rounded", F.round("rating", 0))
)

    base
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("rating_rounded") >= 75, "high").when(F.col("rating_rounded") >= 37, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("rating_rounded_bucket"),
    )

)

)

    amount,
    txn_type,
    LAST_VALUE(txn_type) OVER (ORDER BY amount, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS last_txn_type
FROM transactions
WHERE txn_type IN ('REFUND', 'FEE', 'CREDIT')
code:

)

sql:
with supplier_summary as (
    select supplier_id, round((100 * sum(case when category = 'Books' then 1 else 0 end)) / count(*), 1) as pct_books, count(stock_qty) as stock_qty_count
    from products
    where product_name is not null
    group by supplier_id
)
select
    s.id,
    s.rating,
    s.city,
    ss.pct_books,
    ss.stock_qty_count
from suppliers s
left outer join supplier_summary ss on s.id = ss.supplier_id
order by s.city desc, pct_books
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

supplier_summary = (
    df_products
    .filter(F.col("product_name").isNotNull())
    .groupBy("supplier_id")
    .agg(
        F.round(((100 * F.sum(F.when(F.col("category") == "Books", 1).otherwise(0))) / F.count("*")), 1).alias("pct_books"),
        F.count("stock_qty").alias("stock_qty_count"),
    )
)

result = (
    df_suppliers.alias("s")
    .join(supplier_summary.alias("ss"), F.col("s.id") == F.col("ss.supplier_id"), "left")
    .select(
        F.col("s.id"),
        F.col("s.rating"),
        F.col("s.city"),
        F.col("ss.pct_books"),
        F.col("ss.stock_qty_count"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("city").desc(), "pct_books")
)

with base as (
    select *
    from shipments
    where delivered_date <= '2024-04-20' and order_id = 15 and status <> 'IN_TRANSIT'
),
shipments_stats as (
    select status, max(cost) - min(cost) as cost_range, count(distinct cost) as unique_carriers

    .filter(F.col("cost_range") < 52)

sql:
SELECT
    CASE WHEN YEAR(signup_date) < 2024 THEN 'before_2024' WHEN YEAR(signup_date) = 2024 THEN '2024' ELSE 'after_2024' END AS signup_cohort,
    SUM(age) AS total_age,
    ROUND(AVG(credit_limit), 2) AS avg_credit_limit,
    CONCAT_WS(', ', SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(segment))) AS segment_values
FROM customers
WHERE age >= 33 AND signup_date <= '2023-11-01' AND credit_limit > 13700
GROUP BY CASE WHEN YEAR(signup_date) < 2024 THEN 'before_2024' WHEN YEAR(signup_date) = 2024 THEN '2024' ELSE 'after_2024' END
HAVING SUM(age) < 350;

from pyspark.sql import functions as F

    df_customers
    .filter((F.col("age") >= 33) & (F.col("signup_date") <= "2023-11-01") & (F.col("credit_limit") > 13700))
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.year("signup_date") < 2024, "before_2024").when(F.year("signup_date") == 2024, "2024").otherwise("after_2024").alias("signup_cohort"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.sum("age").alias("total_age"),
        F.round(F.avg("credit_limit"), 2).alias("avg_credit_limit"),
        F.concat_ws(", ", F.sort_array(F.collect_set("segment"))).alias("segment_values"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("total_age") < 350)
)

    FROM accounts
    GROUP BY customer_id
)

sql:
select
    c.id,
    c.signup_date,
    t.cancelled_count,
    t.plan_list
from customers c
inner join (select customer_id, sum(case when status = 'CANCELLED' then 1 else 0 end) as cancelled_count, sort_array(collect_set(plan)) as plan_list
    from subscriptions
    group by customer_id) t on c.id = t.customer_id
order by 2, id desc
limit 3;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

customer_totals = (
    df_subscriptions
    .groupBy("customer_id")
    .agg(
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("status") == "CANCELLED", 1).otherwise(0)).alias("cancelled_count"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("plan")).alias("plan_list"),
    )
)

result = (
    df_customers.alias("c")
    .join(customer_totals.alias("t"), F.col("c.id") == F.col("t.customer_id"), "inner")
    .select(
        F.col("c.id"),
        F.col("c.signup_date"),
        F.col("t.cancelled_count"),
        F.col("t.plan_list"),
    )
    .orderBy("signup_date", F.col("id").desc())
    .limit(3)
)

sql:
SELECT CASE WHEN YEAR(o.order_date) < 2024 THEN 'before_2024' WHEN YEAR(o.order_date) = 2024 THEN '2024' ELSE 'after_2024' END AS order_cohort, o.channel, ROUND(AVG(s.cost), 2) AS avg_cost
FROM shipments s
INNER JOIN orders o ON s.order_id = o.id
GROUP BY CASE WHEN YEAR(o.order_date) < 2024 THEN 'before_2024' WHEN YEAR(o.order_date) = 2024 THEN '2024' ELSE 'after_2024' END, o.channel
HAVING avg_cost >= 71;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_shipments.alias("s")
    .join(df_orders.alias("o"), F.col("s.order_id") == F.col("o.id"), "inner")
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.year(F.col("o.order_date")) < 2024, "before_2024").when(F.year(F.col("o.order_date")) == 2024, "2024").otherwise("after_2024").alias("order_cohort"),
        F.col("o.channel"),
    )
    .agg(F.round(F.avg(F.col("s.cost")), 2).alias("avg_cost"))

sql:
SELECT
    order_id,
    MAX(unit_price) max_unit_price,
    MAX(quantity) max_quantity,
    MAX(quantity) - MIN(quantity) quantity_range
FROM order_items
GROUP BY order_id
HAVING SUM(unit_price * quantity) > 55;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_order_items
    .groupBy("order_id")
    .agg(
        F.max("unit_price").alias("max_unit_price"),
        F.max("quantity").alias("max_quantity"),
        (F.max("quantity") - F.min("quantity")).alias("quantity_range"),
        F.sum((F.col("unit_price") * F.col("quantity"))).alias("revenue"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("revenue") > 55)
    .drop("revenue")
)

from payments p
left join orders o on p.order_id = o.id

WITH Base AS (
    SELECT *, SUBSTRING(full_name, 1, 2) AS full_name_prefix
    FROM employees
    WHERE full_name NOT LIKE '%Oli%' AND manager_id = 34
),
agg AS (
    SELECT CASE WHEN YEAR(hire_date) < 2024 THEN 'before_2024' WHEN YEAR(hire_date) = 2024 THEN '2024' ELSE 'after_2024' END AS hire_cohort, CONCAT_WS(', ', SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(job_title))) AS job_title_values
    FROM Base
    GROUP BY CASE WHEN YEAR(hire_date) < 2024 THEN 'before_2024' WHEN YEAR(hire_date) = 2024 THEN '2024' ELSE 'after_2024' END
)
SELECT hire_cohort, job_title_values
FROM agg
ORDER BY hire_cohort
LIMIT 50;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

base = (
    df_employees
    .filter(~F.col("full_name").like("%Oli%") & (F.col("manager_id") == 34))
    .withColumn("full_name_prefix", F.substring("full_name", 1, 2))
)

agg = (
    base
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.year("hire_date") < 2024, "before_2024").when(F.year("hire_date") == 2024, "2024").otherwise("after_2024").alias("hire_cohort"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.concat_ws(", ", F.sort_array(F.collect_set("job_title"))).alias("job_title_values"),
    )
)

result = (
    agg
    .select("hire_cohort", "job_title_values")
    .orderBy("hire_cohort")
    .limit(50)
)

WITH account_summary AS (
    SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) total_count, ROUND((100 * SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'CREDIT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) / COUNT(*), 1) pct_credit
    FROM transactions
    WHERE is_flagged
    GROUP BY account_id
)

    df_accounts.alias("a")
