sql:
WITH AccountsByCustomer AS (
    SELECT customer_id, ROUND((100 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'OPEN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) / COUNT(*), 1) pct_open, CONCAT_WS(', ', SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(status))) status_values
    FROM accounts
    GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT
    c.id,
    c.age,
    A.pct_open,
    A.status_values
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN AccountsByCustomer A ON c.id = A.customer_id
ORDER BY c.age DESC, A.pct_open
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

accounts_by_customer = (
    df_accounts
    .groupBy("customer_id")
    .agg(
        F.round(((100 * F.sum(F.when(F.col("status") == "OPEN", 1).otherwise(0))) / F.count("*")), 1).alias("pct_open"),
        F.concat_ws(", ", F.sort_array(F.collect_set("status"))).alias("status_values"),
    )
)

result = (
    df_customers.alias("c")
    .join(accounts_by_customer.alias("A"), F.col("c.id") == F.col("A.customer_id"), "left")
    .select(
        F.col("c.id"),
        F.col("c.age"),
        F.col("A.pct_open"),
        F.col("A.status_values"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("age").desc(), "pct_open")
)

SELECT CASE WHEN YEAR(hire_date) < 2024 THEN 'before_2024' WHEN YEAR(hire_date) = 2024 THEN '2024' ELSE 'after_2024' END AS hire_cohort, CASE WHEN salary >= 138000 THEN 'high' WHEN salary >= 75000 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS salary_bucket, ROUND(AVG(salary), 2) AS avg_salary
FROM employees

sql: SELECT CASE WHEN o.discount >= 0.4 THEN 'high' WHEN o.discount >= 0.06 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS discount_bucket, o.customer_id, ROUND((100 * SUM(CASE WHEN p.status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_success FROM payments p LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.id = p.order_id WHERE HOUR(p.paid_at) BETWEEN 12 AND 15 GROUP BY CASE WHEN o.discount >= 0.4 THEN 'high' WHEN o.discount >= 0.06 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END, o.customer_id ORDER BY discount_bucket DESC;

    .join(df_orders.alias("o"), F.col("o.id") == F.col("p.order_id"), "left")

sql:
with valid_web_events as (
    select *
    from web_events
    where page in ('/checkout', '/home', '/product')
),
event_cohort_summary as (
    select
        case when year(event_time) < 2024 then 'before_2024' when year(event_time) = 2024 then '2024' else 'after_2024' end as event_cohort,
        case when event_type in ('click', 'search') then 'group_a' else 'other' end as event_type_group,
        sum(case when event_type = 'purchase' then 1 else 0 end) as purchase_count,
        count(distinct duration_sec) as unique_pages
    from valid_web_events
    group by case when year(event_time) < 2024 then 'before_2024' when year(event_time) = 2024 then '2024' else 'after_2024' end, case when event_type in ('click', 'search') then 'group_a' else 'other' end
)
select
    event_cohort,
    event_type_group,
    purchase_count,
    unique_pages
from event_cohort_summary
where purchase_count < 47
order by event_cohort, event_type_group
limit 10
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

valid_web_events = df_web_events.filter(F.col("page").isin(["/checkout", "/home", "/product"]))

event_cohort_summary = (
    valid_web_events
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.year("event_time") < 2024, "before_2024").when(F.year("event_time") == 2024, "2024").otherwise("after_2024").alias("event_cohort"),
        F.when(F.col("event_type").isin(["click", "search"]), "group_a").otherwise("other").alias("event_type_group"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("event_type") == "purchase", 1).otherwise(0)).alias("purchase_count"),
        F.countDistinct("duration_sec").alias("unique_pages"),
    )
)

result = (
    event_cohort_summary
    .filter(F.col("purchase_count") < 47)
    .select("event_cohort", "event_type_group", "purchase_count", "unique_pages")
    .orderBy("event_cohort", "event_type_group")
    .limit(10)
)

sql:
select case when year(o.order_date) < 2024 then 'before_2024' when year(o.order_date) = 2024 then '2024' else 'after_2024' end as order_cohort, min(s.cost) as min_cost, concat_ws(', ', sort_array(collect_set(s.carrier))) as carrier_values
from shipments s
left join orders o on s.order_id = o.id
group by case when year(o.order_date) < 2024 then 'before_2024' when year(o.order_date) = 2024 then '2024' else 'after_2024' end
order by min_cost desc, order_cohort asc
limit 1
code:

    df_shipments.alias("s")

WITH filtered_transactions AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM transactions
    WHERE (txn_type NOT IN ('FEE', 'REFUND', 'DEBIT') AND merchant = 'Shell') OR account_id IN (9, 13, 15)
),
transactions_stats AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', txn_time) AS txn_month, COUNT(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'FEE' THEN 1 END) AS fee_count, SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'CREDIT' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS credit_amount

)

    filtered_transactions
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("MONTH", "txn_time").alias("txn_month"))

        F.count(F.when(F.col("txn_type") == "FEE", 1)).alias("fee_count"),

    )
)

result = transactions_stats

        MAX(budget) AS max_budget
    FROM recent_departments
    GROUP BY location, CASE WHEN budget >= 3104000 THEN 'high' WHEN budget >= 1433000 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END

    CASE WHEN amount >= 1530 THEN 'high' WHEN amount >= 440 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS amount_bucket,
    status,
    COUNT(DISTINCT amount) AS unique_methods,
    ROUND(STDDEV(amount), 2) AS stddev_amount
FROM payments
WHERE amount > 1380
GROUP BY CASE WHEN amount >= 1530 THEN 'high' WHEN amount >= 440 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END, status
ORDER BY 3 DESC
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_payments
    .filter(F.col("amount") > 1380)
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("amount") >= 1530, "high").when(F.col("amount") >= 440, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("amount_bucket"),
        "status",
    )
    .agg(
        F.countDistinct("amount").alias("unique_methods"),
        F.round(F.stddev("amount"), 2).alias("stddev_amount"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("unique_methods").desc())
)

sql:
SELECT
    DATE_FORMAT(end_date, 'yyyy-MM') AS end_month,
    MAX(start_date) AS last_start_date,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN plan = 'enterprise' THEN 1 END) AS enterprise_count,
    SUM(monthly_fee) AS total_monthly_fee
FROM subscriptions
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(end_date, 'yyyy-MM')
HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN plan = 'standard' THEN 1 END) > 3
ORDER BY enterprise_count
code:

        F.count(F.when(F.col("plan") == "enterprise", 1)).alias("enterprise_count"),
        F.sum("monthly_fee").alias("total_monthly_fee"),

    )
    .filter(F.col("standard_count") > 3)

    .orderBy("enterprise_count")
)

sql:
SELECT
    amount_bucket,
    method,
    num_payments,
    min_amount
FROM (
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN amount >= 1290 THEN 'high' WHEN amount >= 440 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END amount_bucket,
        method,
        COUNT(*) num_payments,
        MIN(amount) min_amount
    FROM payments
    WHERE status = 'SUCCESS'
    GROUP BY CASE WHEN amount >= 1290 THEN 'high' WHEN amount >= 440 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END, method
) t
WHERE num_payments >= 8
ORDER BY amount_bucket
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_payments
    .filter(F.col("status") == "SUCCESS")
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("amount") >= 1290, "high").when(F.col("amount") >= 440, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("amount_bucket"),
        "method",
    )
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("num_payments"),
        F.min("amount").alias("min_amount"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("num_payments") >= 8)
    .select("amount_bucket", "method", "num_payments", "min_amount")
    .orderBy("amount_bucket")
)

    stores.city,
    sort_array(collect_set(orders.channel)) as channel_list,
    count(distinct orders.shipping_fee) as unique_statuss
from orders
join stores on stores.id = orders.store_id
join customers on customers.id = orders.customer_id
where stores.region not in ('Central', 'North')
group by case when stores.sqft >= 14057 then 'high' when stores.sqft >= 6598 then 'mid' else 'low' end, stores.city
having count(distinct orders.shipping_fee) >= 2
order by sqft_bucket, unique_statuss desc, city
limit 1;

    .filter(~F.col("stores.region").isin(["Central", "North"]))
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("stores.sqft") >= 14057, "high").when(F.col("stores.sqft") >= 6598, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("sqft_bucket"),
        F.col("stores.city"),

sql:
WITH base AS (
    SELECT *, DATEDIFF(delivered_date, shipped_date) AS days_shipped_date_to_delivered_date
    FROM shipments
    WHERE delivered_date <= '2025-04-23' AND shipped_date < '2023-07-01'
),
shipments_stats AS (
    SELECT
        status,
        carrier,
        SUM(CASE WHEN carrier = 'Flash' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS flash_count,
        MAX(days_shipped_date_to_delivered_date) - MIN(days_shipped_date_to_delivered_date) AS days_shipped_date_to_delivered_date_range
    FROM base
    GROUP BY status, carrier
)
SELECT status, carrier, days_shipped_date_to_delivered_date_range
FROM shipments_stats
ORDER BY status DESC;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

base = (
    df_shipments
    .filter((F.col("delivered_date") <= "2025-04-23") & (F.col("shipped_date") < "2023-07-01"))
    .withColumn("days_shipped_date_to_delivered_date", F.datediff("delivered_date", "shipped_date"))
)

shipments_stats = (
    base
    .groupBy("status", "carrier")
    .agg(
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("carrier") == "Flash", 1).otherwise(0)).alias("flash_count"),
        (F.max("days_shipped_date_to_delivered_date") - F.min("days_shipped_date_to_delivered_date")).alias("days_shipped_date_to_delivered_date_range"),
    )
)

result = (
    shipments_stats
    .select("status", "carrier", "days_shipped_date_to_delivered_date_range")
    .orderBy(F.col("status").desc())
)

sql:
WITH recent_products AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM products
    WHERE supplier_id = 9 AND supplier_id IN (21, 23, 24) AND launch_date < '2024-03-01'
),
supplier_id_summary AS (
    SELECT
        supplier_id,
        DATE_FORMAT(launch_date, 'yyyy-MM') launch_month,
        CONCAT_WS(', ', SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(category))) category_values,
        MIN(cost) min_cost
    FROM recent_products
    GROUP BY supplier_id, DATE_FORMAT(launch_date, 'yyyy-MM')
)
SELECT *
FROM supplier_id_summary
ORDER BY supplier_id DESC, launch_month;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

recent_products = (
    df_products
    .filter((F.col("supplier_id") == 9) & F.col("supplier_id").isin([21, 23, 24]) & (F.col("launch_date") < "2024-03-01"))
)

supplier_id_summary = (
    recent_products
    .groupBy(
        "supplier_id",
        F.date_format("launch_date", "yyyy-MM").alias("launch_month"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.concat_ws(", ", F.sort_array(F.collect_set("category"))).alias("category_values"),
        F.min("cost").alias("min_cost"),
    )
)

result = supplier_id_summary.orderBy(F.col("supplier_id").desc(), "launch_month")

sql:
SELECT CASE WHEN amount >= 3300 THEN 'high' WHEN amount >= 1900 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS amount_bucket, ROUND((100 * SUM(CASE WHEN merchant = 'Shell' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_shell, ROUND(AVG(amount), 2) AS avg_amount
FROM transactions
WHERE is_flagged = FALSE AND amount < 1900
GROUP BY amount_bucket
ORDER BY pct_shell DESC, amount_bucket
LIMIT 20;
code:

    df_transactions

    )

        F.round(F.avg("amount"), 2).alias("avg_amount"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("pct_shell").desc(), "amount_bucket")
    .limit(20)
)

with src as (
    select *, cast(quantity as string) as quantity_str
    from inventory
    where last_restock between '2023-05-01' and '2025-04-01' and product_id in (3, 5, 10)
),
summary as (
    select case when quantity >= 203 then 'high' when quantity >= 42 then 'mid' else 'low' end as quantity_bucket, round(avg(quantity), 2) as avg_quantity
    from src
    group by case when quantity >= 203 then 'high' when quantity >= 42 then 'mid' else 'low' end
)
select quantity_bucket, avg_quantity
from summary
where avg_quantity >= 42
order by avg_quantity desc

    .withColumn("quantity_str", F.col("quantity").cast("string"))
)

summary = (
    src
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("quantity") >= 203, "high").when(F.col("quantity") >= 42, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("quantity_bucket"),
    )
    .agg(F.round(F.avg("quantity"), 2).alias("avg_quantity"))
)

result = (
    summary
    .filter(F.col("avg_quantity") >= 42)
    .select("quantity_bucket", "avg_quantity")
    .orderBy(F.col("avg_quantity").desc())
)

select case when unit_price >= 330 then 'high' when unit_price >= 90 then 'mid' else 'low' end as unit_price_bucket, count(distinct unit_price) as unique_products
from order_items
where unit_price between 140 and 390 and unit_price between 110 and 180 and product_id in (19, 33, 37, 38)
group by case when unit_price >= 330 then 'high' when unit_price >= 90 then 'mid' else 'low' end
having min(unit_price) >= 260
order by unique_products desc;

        F.when(F.col("unit_price") >= 330, "high").when(F.col("unit_price") >= 90, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("unit_price_bucket"),

    .agg(
        F.countDistinct("unit_price").alias("unique_products"),
        F.min("unit_price").alias("min_unit_price"),

    .filter(F.col("min_unit_price") >= 260)

sql: WITH src AS (SELECT * FROM transactions WHERE txn_type = 'FEE' AND (txn_time >= '2024-03-01' OR TO_DATE(txn_time) >= '2025-01-01')), amount_bucket_summary AS (SELECT CASE WHEN amount >= 4500 THEN 'high' WHEN amount >= 600 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS amount_bucket, CASE WHEN txn_type IN ('CREDIT', 'DEBIT') THEN 'core' ELSE 'other' END AS txn_type_group, SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(merchant)) AS merchant_list, COUNT(amount) AS amount_count FROM src GROUP BY CASE WHEN amount >= 4500 THEN 'high' WHEN amount >= 600 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END, CASE WHEN txn_type IN ('CREDIT', 'DEBIT') THEN 'core' ELSE 'other' END) SELECT amount_bucket, txn_type_group, merchant_list, amount_count FROM amount_bucket_summary WHERE amount_count > 4 ORDER BY txn_type_group DESC, amount_bucket LIMIT 5

    .filter((F.col("txn_type") == "FEE") & ((F.col("txn_time") >= "2024-03-01") | (F.to_date("txn_time") >= "2025-01-01")))
)

amount_bucket_summary = (

    .groupBy(

    )
)

    s.city,
    ROUND((100 * SUM(CASE WHEN o.channel = 'mobile' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_mobile,
    CONCAT_WS(', ', SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(o.status))) AS status_values
FROM orders o
LEFT JOIN stores s ON o.store_id = s.id
GROUP BY CASE WHEN s.sqft >= 14871 THEN 'high' WHEN s.sqft >= 7891 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END, s.city

SELECT
    event_month,
    event_cohort,
    avg_duration_sec,
    last_event_time
FROM (
    SELECT
        MONTH(event_time) AS event_month,
        CASE WHEN YEAR(event_time) < 2024 THEN 'before_2024' WHEN YEAR(event_time) = 2024 THEN '2024' ELSE 'after_2024' END AS event_cohort,
        ROUND(AVG(duration_sec), 2) AS avg_duration_sec,
        MAX(event_time) AS last_event_time
    FROM web_events
    WHERE duration_sec BETWEEN 173 AND 258
    GROUP BY MONTH(event_time), CASE WHEN YEAR(event_time) < 2024 THEN 'before_2024' WHEN YEAR(event_time) = 2024 THEN '2024' ELSE 'after_2024' END
) AS t
WHERE avg_duration_sec < 43
ORDER BY event_month DESC;

from pyspark.sql import functions as F

    df_web_events
    .filter(F.col("duration_sec").between(173, 258))
    .groupBy(
        F.month("event_time").alias("event_month"),
        F.when(F.year("event_time") < 2024, "before_2024").when(F.year("event_time") == 2024, "2024").otherwise("after_2024").alias("event_cohort"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.round(F.avg("duration_sec"), 2).alias("avg_duration_sec"),
        F.max("event_time").alias("last_event_time"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("avg_duration_sec") < 43)
    .select("event_month", "event_cohort", "avg_duration_sec", "last_event_time")
    .orderBy(F.col("event_month").desc())
)

from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_products.alias("p")
    .join(df_suppliers.alias("s"), F.col("p.supplier_id") == F.col("s.id"), "inner")
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("s.rating") >= 3.8, "high").when(F.col("s.rating") >= 1.6, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("rating_bucket"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("product_count"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("p.category") == "Fashion", F.col("p.stock_qty")).otherwise(0)).alias("fashion_stock_qty"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("product_count") >= 2)
    .orderBy(F.col("product_count").desc(), "rating_bucket")
)

sql: SELECT CASE WHEN c.age >= 59 THEN 'high' WHEN c.age >= 42 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS age_bucket, SUM(CASE WHEN o.channel = 'web' THEN o.shipping_fee ELSE 0 END) AS web_shipping_fee FROM orders o JOIN stores s ON o.store_id = s.id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY CASE WHEN c.age >= 59 THEN 'high' WHEN c.age >= 42 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN o.channel = 'web' THEN o.shipping_fee ELSE 0 END) >= 38 ORDER BY web_shipping_fee DESC, age_bucket
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

    df_orders.alias("o")
    .join(df_stores.alias("s"), F.col("o.store_id") == F.col("s.id"), "inner")
    .join(df_customers.alias("c"), F.col("o.customer_id") == F.col("c.id"), "inner")
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("c.age") >= 59, "high").when(F.col("c.age") >= 42, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("age_bucket"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("o.channel") == "web", F.col("o.shipping_fee")).otherwise(0)).alias("web_shipping_fee"),
    )

)

sql: WITH base AS (SELECT * FROM order_items WHERE order_id IN (5, 12, 15) AND (quantity BETWEEN 3 AND 4 OR unit_price BETWEEN 120 AND 220)), OrderItemsStats AS (SELECT CASE WHEN unit_price >= 400 THEN 'high' WHEN unit_price >= 170 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS unit_price_bucket, ROUND(STDDEV(quantity), 2) AS stddev_quantity FROM base GROUP BY CASE WHEN unit_price >= 400 THEN 'high' WHEN unit_price >= 170 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END) SELECT * FROM OrderItemsStats WHERE stddev_quantity < 23 ORDER BY unit_price_bucket ASC, stddev_quantity ASC;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

base = (
    df_order_items
    .filter(F.col("order_id").isin([5, 12, 15]) & (F.col("quantity").between(3, 4) | F.col("unit_price").between(120, 220)))
)

order_items_stats = (
    base
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("unit_price") >= 400, "high").when(F.col("unit_price") >= 170, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("unit_price_bucket"),
    )
    .agg(F.round(F.stddev("quantity"), 2).alias("stddev_quantity"))
)

result = (
    order_items_stats
    .filter(F.col("stddev_quantity") < 23)
    .orderBy("unit_price_bucket", "stddev_quantity")
)

WITH filtered_departments AS (
    SELECT *, SUBSTRING(location, 1, 2) AS location_prefix
    FROM departments
    WHERE dept_name = 'Legal'
),
summary AS (
    SELECT CASE WHEN budget >= 3333000 THEN 'high' WHEN budget >= 642000 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS budget_bucket, MIN(budget) AS min_budget
    FROM filtered_departments
    GROUP BY CASE WHEN budget >= 3333000 THEN 'high' WHEN budget >= 642000 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END
)

)

SELECT
    unit_price_bucket,
    quantity_bucket,
    revenue,
    stddev_quantity
FROM (
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN unit_price >= 420 THEN 'high' WHEN unit_price >= 190 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS unit_price_bucket,
        CASE WHEN quantity >= 7 THEN 'high' WHEN quantity >= 3 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS quantity_bucket,
        SUM(quantity * unit_price) AS revenue,
        ROUND(STDDEV(quantity), 2) AS stddev_quantity
    FROM order_items
    GROUP BY CASE WHEN unit_price >= 420 THEN 'high' WHEN unit_price >= 190 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END, CASE WHEN quantity >= 7 THEN 'high' WHEN quantity >= 3 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END
) AS t
WHERE revenue < 42;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_order_items
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("unit_price") >= 420, "high").when(F.col("unit_price") >= 190, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("unit_price_bucket"),
        F.when(F.col("quantity") >= 7, "high").when(F.col("quantity") >= 3, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("quantity_bucket"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.sum((F.col("quantity") * F.col("unit_price"))).alias("revenue"),
        F.round(F.stddev("quantity"), 2).alias("stddev_quantity"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("revenue") < 42)
    .select("unit_price_bucket", "quantity_bucket", "revenue", "stddev_quantity")
)

sql: SELECT channel, ROUND((100 * SUM(CASE WHEN channel = 'web' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_web FROM orders WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL AND (store_id IN (6, 19) OR store_id IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY channel ORDER BY pct_web DESC

sql: SELECT quantity_bucket, store_id, max_quantity, inventory_count FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN quantity >= 217 THEN 'high' WHEN quantity >= 72 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS quantity_bucket, store_id, MAX(quantity) AS max_quantity, COUNT(*) AS inventory_count FROM inventory WHERE product_id = 4 GROUP BY CASE WHEN quantity >= 217 THEN 'high' WHEN quantity >= 72 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END, store_id) AS t WHERE max_quantity >= 230 ORDER BY quantity_bucket DESC, store_id LIMIT 10
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_inventory
    .filter(F.col("product_id") == 4)
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("quantity") >= 217, "high").when(F.col("quantity") >= 72, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("quantity_bucket"),
        "store_id",
    )
    .agg(
        F.max("quantity").alias("max_quantity"),
        F.count("*").alias("inventory_count"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("max_quantity") >= 230)
    .select("quantity_bucket", "store_id", "max_quantity", "inventory_count")
    .orderBy(F.col("quantity_bucket").desc(), "store_id")
    .limit(10)
)

LEFT OUTER JOIN products ON products.id = store_sales.product_id
INNER JOIN stores ON store_sales.store_id = stores.id
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', stores.opened_date), CASE WHEN stores.sqft >= 17820 THEN 'high' WHEN stores.sqft >= 6122 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END
ORDER BY sqft_bucket DESC, opened_month DESC
LIMIT 5

result = (
    df_store_sales.alias("store_sales")
    .join(df_products.alias("products"), F.col("products.id") == F.col("store_sales.product_id"), "left")
    .join(df_stores.alias("stores"), F.col("store_sales.store_id") == F.col("stores.id"), "inner")
    .groupBy(
        F.date_trunc("MONTH", F.col("stores.opened_date")).alias("opened_month"),
        F.when(F.col("stores.sqft") >= 17820, "high").when(F.col("stores.sqft") >= 6122, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("sqft_bucket"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.sum(F.col("store_sales.units")).alias("total_units"),
        F.min(F.col("store_sales.sale_date")).alias("first_sale_date"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("sqft_bucket").desc(), F.col("opened_month").desc())
    .limit(5)
)

sql:
SELECT
    CASE WHEN units >= 43 THEN 'high' WHEN units >= 19 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END units_bucket,
    product_id,
    MAX(sale_date) latest_sale_date,
    MAX(units) - MIN(units) units_range,
    COUNT(*) cnt
FROM store_sales
WHERE revenue BETWEEN 1300 AND 2600 AND units > 13
GROUP BY CASE WHEN units >= 43 THEN 'high' WHEN units >= 19 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END, product_id
HAVING MAX(units) - MIN(units) >= 39
ORDER BY latest_sale_date ASC;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_store_sales
    .filter(F.col("revenue").between(1300, 2600) & (F.col("units") > 13))
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("units") >= 43, "high").when(F.col("units") >= 19, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("units_bucket"),
        "product_id",
    )
    .agg(
        F.max("sale_date").alias("latest_sale_date"),
        (F.max("units") - F.min("units")).alias("units_range"),
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("units_range") >= 39)
    .orderBy("latest_sale_date")
)

)

SELECT
    id,
    duration_sec,
    event_time,
    LAST_VALUE(event_time) OVER (ORDER BY duration_sec DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) last_event_time,
    LEAD(duration_sec, 1, 0) OVER (ORDER BY event_time, id) next_duration_sec
FROM web_events
WHERE duration_sec != 214
ORDER BY duration_sec DESC;
code:

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

    .filter(F.col("duration_sec") != 214)

        "id",

        "event_time",
        F.last("event_time").over(w).alias("last_event_time"),
        F.lead("duration_sec", 1, 0).over(w2).alias("next_duration_sec"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("duration_sec").desc())
)

SELECT
    CASE WHEN discount >= 0.41 THEN 'high' WHEN discount >= 0.07 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS discount_bucket,
    CASE WHEN YEAR(order_date) < 2024 THEN 'before_2024' WHEN YEAR(order_date) = 2024 THEN '2024' ELSE 'after_2024' END AS order_cohort,
    COUNT(discount) AS discount_count,
    SUM(amount) AS total_amount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN channel = 'mobile' THEN discount ELSE 0 END) AS mobile_discount
FROM orders
GROUP BY CASE WHEN discount >= 0.41 THEN 'high' WHEN discount >= 0.07 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END, CASE WHEN YEAR(order_date) < 2024 THEN 'before_2024' WHEN YEAR(order_date) = 2024 THEN '2024' ELSE 'after_2024' END

        F.when(F.year("order_date") < 2024, "before_2024").when(F.year("order_date") == 2024, "2024").otherwise("after_2024").alias("order_cohort"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count("discount").alias("discount_count"),
        F.sum("amount").alias("total_amount"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("channel") == "mobile", F.col("discount")).otherwise(0)).alias("mobile_discount"),

WITH Base AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM employees
    WHERE full_name IS NOT NULL AND (job_title <> 'Manager' OR level IN ('L5', 'L1', 'L4'))
),
employees_stats AS (
    SELECT level, ROUND(STDDEV(salary), 2) AS stddev_salary, CONCAT_WS(', ', SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(level))) AS level_values
    FROM Base
    GROUP BY level
)
SELECT level, stddev_salary, level_values

)

employees_stats = (
    base
    .groupBy("level")
    .agg(
        F.round(F.stddev("salary"), 2).alias("stddev_salary"),
        F.concat_ws(", ", F.sort_array(F.collect_set("level"))).alias("level_values"),
    )
)

result = (
    employees_stats
    .filter(F.col("stddev_salary") < 79)
    .select("level", "stddev_salary", "level_values")
)

    df_store_sales

    .select(
        F.col("p.id"),
        F.col("p.cost"),
        F.col("p.launch_date"),
        F.col("pt.latest_sale_date"),
    )
    .orderBy("latest_sale_date")
)

sql:
SELECT
    brand,
    CASE WHEN brand IN ('Globex', 'Stark') THEN 'tier_1' ELSE 'other' END AS brand_group,
    CONCAT_WS(', ', SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(brand))) AS brand_values,
    MIN(launch_date) AS first_launch_date,
    SUM(cost) AS total_cost
FROM products
WHERE brand <> 'Umbrella' OR cost IS NULL
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY first_launch_date DESC, brand;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_products
    .filter((F.col("brand") != "Umbrella") | F.col("cost").isNull())
    .groupBy(
        "brand",
        F.when(F.col("brand").isin(["Globex", "Stark"]), "tier_1").otherwise("other").alias("brand_group"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.concat_ws(", ", F.sort_array(F.collect_set("brand"))).alias("brand_values"),
        F.min("launch_date").alias("first_launch_date"),
        F.sum("cost").alias("total_cost"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("first_launch_date").desc(), "brand")
)

    MONTH(s.opened_date) AS opened_month,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN o.amount ELSE 0 END) AS completed_amount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'PENDING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending_count
FROM orders o
JOIN stores s ON o.store_id = s.id
WHERE s.opened_date >= '2024-02-01'
GROUP BY s.city, MONTH(s.opened_date);
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_orders.alias("o")
    .join(df_stores.alias("s"), F.col("o.store_id") == F.col("s.id"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("s.opened_date") >= "2024-02-01")
    .groupBy(F.col("s.city"), F.month(F.col("s.opened_date")).alias("opened_month"))
    .agg(
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("o.status") == "COMPLETED", F.col("o.amount")).otherwise(0)).alias("completed_amount"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("o.status") == "PENDING", 1).otherwise(0)).alias("pending_count"),
    )
)

sql: SELECT CASE WHEN quantity >= 7 THEN 'high' WHEN quantity >= 3 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS quantity_bucket, COUNT(*) AS order_item_count, MAX(unit_price) - MIN(unit_price) AS unit_price_range, COUNT(unit_price) AS unit_price_count FROM order_items GROUP BY quantity_bucket ORDER BY unit_price_count DESC, unit_price_range DESC

sql:
WITH payments_by_order AS (
    SELECT order_id, COUNT(DISTINCT amount) AS unique_methods
    FROM payments
    GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT
    o.id,
    o.customer_id,
    o.channel,
    pbo.unique_methods
FROM orders o
INNER JOIN payments_by_order pbo ON o.id = pbo.order_id
WHERE pbo.unique_methods > 8
ORDER BY o.channel, id
LIMIT 10
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

payments_by_order = (
    df_payments
    .groupBy("order_id")
    .agg(F.countDistinct("amount").alias("unique_methods"))
)

result = (
    df_orders.alias("o")
    .join(payments_by_order.alias("pbo"), F.col("o.id") == F.col("pbo.order_id"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("pbo.unique_methods") > 8)
    .select(
        F.col("o.id"),
        F.col("o.customer_id"),
        F.col("o.channel"),
        F.col("pbo.unique_methods"),
    )
    .orderBy("channel", "id")
    .limit(10)
)

sql:
select case when amount >= 1280 then 'high' when amount >= 490 then 'mid' else 'low' end as amount_bucket, round((100 * sum(case when method = 'card' then 1 else 0 end)) / count(*), 1) as pct_card
from payments
where status != 'REFUNDED'
group by case when amount >= 1280 then 'high' when amount >= 490 then 'mid' else 'low' end
order by pct_card desc, amount_bucket desc
limit 1
code:

    df_payments

sql: with src as (select *, datediff(current_date(), last_restock) as days_since_last_restock from inventory where month(last_restock) in (4, 9, 10) and quantity between 208 and 238 and quantity > 193), summary as (select case when days_since_last_restock >= 60 then 'high' when days_since_last_restock >= 30 then 'mid' else 'low' end as days_since_last_restock_bucket, case when quantity >= 262 then 'high' when quantity >= 113 then 'mid' else 'low' end as quantity_bucket, min(last_restock) as first_last_restock from src group by case when days_since_last_restock >= 60 then 'high' when days_since_last_restock >= 30 then 'mid' else 'low' end, case when quantity >= 262 then 'high' when quantity >= 113 then 'mid' else 'low' end) select * from summary order by first_last_restock, days_since_last_restock_bucket desc
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

src = (
    df_inventory
    .filter(F.month("last_restock").isin([4, 9, 10]) & F.col("quantity").between(208, 238) & (F.col("quantity") > 193))
    .withColumn("days_since_last_restock", F.datediff(F.current_date(), "last_restock"))
)

summary = (
    src
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("days_since_last_restock") >= 60, "high").when(F.col("days_since_last_restock") >= 30, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("days_since_last_restock_bucket"),
        F.when(F.col("quantity") >= 262, "high").when(F.col("quantity") >= 113, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("quantity_bucket"),
    )
    .agg(F.min("last_restock").alias("first_last_restock"))
)

result = (
    summary
    .orderBy("first_last_restock", F.col("days_since_last_restock_bucket").desc())
)

SELECT
    MONTH(s.opened_date) AS opened_month,
    CASE WHEN s.sqft >= 17868 THEN 'high' WHEN s.sqft >= 4183 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS sqft_bucket,
    CONCAT_WS(', ', SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(p.status))) AS status_values,
    MIN(p.amount) AS min_amount
FROM payments p
JOIN orders o ON p.order_id = o.id
LEFT JOIN stores s ON o.store_id = s.id
WHERE p.status = 'FAILED'
GROUP BY MONTH(s.opened_date), CASE WHEN s.sqft >= 17868 THEN 'high' WHEN s.sqft >= 4183 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_payments.alias("p")
    .join(df_orders.alias("o"), F.col("p.order_id") == F.col("o.id"), "inner")
    .join(df_stores.alias("s"), F.col("o.store_id") == F.col("s.id"), "left")
    .filter(F.col("p.status") == "FAILED")
    .groupBy(
        F.month(F.col("s.opened_date")).alias("opened_month"),
        F.when(F.col("s.sqft") >= 17868, "high").when(F.col("s.sqft") >= 4183, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("sqft_bucket"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.concat_ws(", ", F.sort_array(F.collect_set(F.col("p.status")))).alias("status_values"),
        F.min(F.col("p.amount")).alias("min_amount"),
    )
)

    departments.dept_name,
    t.total_salary,
    t.director_salary
FROM departments
LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT dept_id, SUM(salary) AS total_salary, SUM(CASE WHEN job_title = 'Director' THEN salary ELSE 0 END) AS director_salary
    FROM employees
    GROUP BY dept_id) t ON departments.id = t.dept_id
WHERE t.director_salary >= 30
ORDER BY departments.location ASC, dept_name ASC;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

department_stats = (
    df_employees
    .groupBy("dept_id")
    .agg(
        F.sum("salary").alias("total_salary"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("job_title") == "Director", F.col("salary")).otherwise(0)).alias("director_salary"),
    )
)

result = (
    df_departments.alias("departments")
    .join(department_stats.alias("t"), F.col("departments.id") == F.col("t.dept_id"), "left")
    .filter(F.col("t.director_salary") >= 30)
    .select(
        F.col("departments.location"),
        F.col("departments.dept_name"),
        F.col("t.total_salary"),
        F.col("t.director_salary"),
    )
    .orderBy("location", "dept_name")
)

sql:
SELECT QUARTER(o.order_date) AS order_quarter, SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'LOST' THEN s.cost ELSE 0 END) AS lost_cost
FROM shipments s
LEFT OUTER JOIN orders o ON s.order_id = o.id
GROUP BY QUARTER(o.order_date)
ORDER BY lost_cost DESC, 1 DESC
LIMIT 1;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

    .join(df_orders.alias("o"), F.col("s.order_id") == F.col("o.id"), "left")

    .agg(
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("s.status") == "LOST", F.col("s.cost")).otherwise(0)).alias("lost_cost"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("lost_cost").desc(), F.col("order_quarter").desc())
    .limit(1)
)

sql:
WITH ValidSuppliers AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM suppliers
    WHERE country <> 'JP' AND city IN ('Berlin', 'New York') AND city IN ('Chiang Mai', 'Berlin', 'Singapore')
),
agg AS (
    SELECT country, MAX(rating) - MIN(rating) AS rating_range, COUNT(DISTINCT rating) AS unique_citys
    FROM ValidSuppliers
    GROUP BY country
)
SELECT country, rating_range, unique_citys
FROM agg
ORDER BY rating_range DESC;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

valid_suppliers = (
    df_suppliers
    .filter((F.col("country") != "JP") & F.col("city").isin(["Berlin", "New York"]) & F.col("city").isin(["Chiang Mai", "Berlin", "Singapore"]))
)

agg = (
    valid_suppliers
    .groupBy("country")
    .agg(
        (F.max("rating") - F.min("rating")).alias("rating_range"),
        F.countDistinct("rating").alias("unique_citys"),
    )
)

result = (
    agg
    .select("country", "rating_range", "unique_citys")
    .orderBy(F.col("rating_range").desc())
)

SELECT CASE WHEN o.amount >= 1590 THEN 'high' WHEN o.amount >= 440 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END amount_bucket, ROUND(STDDEV(oi.quantity), 2) stddev_quantity, ROUND(AVG(oi.quantity), 2) avg_quantity
FROM order_items oi
INNER JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
FULL OUTER JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
WHERE oi.order_id IN (8, 18, 26, 27)
GROUP BY CASE WHEN o.amount >= 1590 THEN 'high' WHEN o.amount >= 440 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END
HAVING ROUND(AVG(oi.quantity), 2) >= 28;

    .filter(F.col("oi.order_id").isin([8, 18, 26, 27]))
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("o.amount") >= 1590, "high").when(F.col("o.amount") >= 440, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("amount_bucket"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.round(F.stddev(F.col("oi.quantity")), 2).alias("stddev_quantity"),

sql:
WITH valid_departments AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM departments
    WHERE budget BETWEEN 1822000 AND 2229000
),
summary AS (
    SELECT CASE WHEN budget >= 4398000 THEN 'high' WHEN budget >= 1249000 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS budget_bucket, ROUND(AVG(budget), 2) AS avg_budget, COUNT(budget) AS budget_count
    FROM valid_departments
    GROUP BY CASE WHEN budget >= 4398000 THEN 'high' WHEN budget >= 1249000 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END
)
SELECT budget_bucket, avg_budget, budget_count
FROM summary
WHERE avg_budget >= 40
ORDER BY budget_count;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

valid_departments = df_departments.filter(F.col("budget").between(1822000, 2229000))

summary = (
    valid_departments
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("budget") >= 4398000, "high").when(F.col("budget") >= 1249000, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("budget_bucket"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.round(F.avg("budget"), 2).alias("avg_budget"),
        F.count("budget").alias("budget_count"),
    )
)

result = (
    summary
    .filter(F.col("avg_budget") >= 40)
    .select("budget_bucket", "avg_budget", "budget_count")
    .orderBy("budget_count")
)

    FROM inventory

    FROM orders
    GROUP BY store_id
)

SELECT c.is_active, ROUND((100 * SUM(CASE WHEN t.txn_type = 'DEBIT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_debit
FROM transactions t
LEFT OUTER JOIN accounts a ON t.account_id = a.id
FULL OUTER JOIN customers c ON a.customer_id = c.id
GROUP BY c.is_active
HAVING ROUND((100 * SUM(CASE WHEN t.txn_type = 'DEBIT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) / COUNT(*), 1) >= 67
ORDER BY pct_debit DESC;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_transactions.alias("t")
    .join(df_accounts.alias("a"), F.col("t.account_id") == F.col("a.id"), "left")
    .join(df_customers.alias("c"), F.col("a.customer_id") == F.col("c.id"), "outer")
    .groupBy(F.col("c.is_active"))
    .agg(
        F.round(((100 * F.sum(F.when(F.col("t.txn_type") == "DEBIT", 1).otherwise(0))) / F.count("*")), 1).alias("pct_debit"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("pct_debit") >= 67)
    .orderBy(F.col("pct_debit").desc())
)

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.orderBy("city")

result = (
    df_stores
    .groupBy("city")
    .agg(
        F.sum("sqft").alias("total_sqft"),
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
    )
    .withColumn("cumulative_sqft", F.sum("total_sqft").over(w))
    .orderBy(F.col("city").desc())
)

sql:
WITH store_summary AS (
    SELECT store_id, MIN(last_restock) AS min_last_restock
    FROM inventory
    WHERE product_id = 9
    GROUP BY store_id
)
SELECT
    s.id,
    s.store_name,
    s.region,
    ss.min_last_restock
FROM stores s
INNER JOIN store_summary ss ON s.id = ss.store_id;

)

    df_stores.alias("s")
    .join(store_summary.alias("ss"), F.col("s.id") == F.col("ss.store_id"), "inner")
    .select(
        F.col("s.id"),
        F.col("s.store_name"),
        F.col("s.region"),
        F.col("ss.min_last_restock"),
    )
)

sql: with base as (select * from web_events where session_id = 19 and page = '/checkout'), WebEventsStats as (select case when year(event_time) < 2024 then 'before_2024' when year(event_time) = 2024 then '2024' else 'after_2024' end as event_cohort, count(duration_sec) as duration_sec_count, avg(duration_sec) as avg_duration_sec from base group by case when year(event_time) < 2024 then 'before_2024' when year(event_time) = 2024 then '2024' else 'after_2024' end) select event_cohort, duration_sec_count, avg_duration_sec from WebEventsStats order by avg_duration_sec;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

base = df_web_events.filter((F.col("session_id") == 19) & (F.col("page") == "/checkout"))

web_events_stats = (
    base
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.year("event_time") < 2024, "before_2024").when(F.year("event_time") == 2024, "2024").otherwise("after_2024").alias("event_cohort"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count("duration_sec").alias("duration_sec_count"),
        F.avg("duration_sec").alias("avg_duration_sec"),
    )
)

result = (
    web_events_stats
    .select("event_cohort", "duration_sec_count", "avg_duration_sec")
    .orderBy("avg_duration_sec")
)

sql:
WITH valid_employees AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM employees
    WHERE MONTH(hire_date) IN (1, 2, 8) AND manager_id IS NULL AND is_remote
),
Summary AS (
    SELECT level, CASE WHEN level IN ('L3', 'L4') THEN 'priority' ELSE 'other' END AS level_group, COUNT(*) AS employee_count
    FROM valid_employees
    GROUP BY level, CASE WHEN level IN ('L3', 'L4') THEN 'priority' ELSE 'other' END
)
SELECT level, level_group, employee_count
FROM Summary;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

valid_employees = (
    df_employees
    .filter(F.month("hire_date").isin([1, 2, 8]) & F.col("manager_id").isNull() & F.col("is_remote"))
)

summary = (
    valid_employees
    .groupBy(
        "level",
        F.when(F.col("level").isin(["L3", "L4"]), "priority").otherwise("other").alias("level_group"),
    )
    .agg(F.count("*").alias("employee_count"))
)

result = summary.select("level", "level_group", "employee_count")

sql:
SELECT YEAR(s.opened_date) AS opened_year, MAX(o.discount) - MIN(o.discount) AS discount_range, COUNT(CASE WHEN o.channel = 'partner' THEN 1 END) AS partner_count
FROM orders o
LEFT JOIN stores s ON o.store_id = s.id
INNER JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id
GROUP BY YEAR(s.opened_date)
ORDER BY opened_year DESC
LIMIT 10
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_orders.alias("o")
    .join(df_stores.alias("s"), F.col("o.store_id") == F.col("s.id"), "left")
    .join(df_customers.alias("c"), F.col("o.customer_id") == F.col("c.id"), "inner")
    .groupBy(F.year(F.col("s.opened_date")).alias("opened_year"))
    .agg(
        (F.max(F.col("o.discount")) - F.min(F.col("o.discount"))).alias("discount_range"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("o.channel") == "partner", 1)).alias("partner_count"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("opened_year").desc())
    .limit(10)
)

SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT status, CASE WHEN YEAR(order_date) < 2024 THEN 'before_2024' WHEN YEAR(order_date) = 2024 THEN '2024' ELSE 'after_2024' END AS order_cohort, COUNT(*) AS total_count
    FROM orders
    WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY status, CASE WHEN YEAR(order_date) < 2024 THEN 'before_2024' WHEN YEAR(order_date) = 2024 THEN '2024' ELSE 'after_2024' END
) AS sub
WHERE total_count > 5
ORDER BY order_cohort, status
LIMIT 50
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

    df_orders
    .filter(F.col("customer_id").isNotNull())

    )
    .agg(F.count("*").alias("total_count"))
    .filter(F.col("total_count") > 5)
    .orderBy("order_cohort", "status")
    .limit(50)
)

from pyspark.sql import functions as F

department_stats = (
    df_employees
    .filter(F.col("is_remote"))
    .groupBy("dept_id")
    .agg(
        F.min("hire_date").alias("first_hire_date"),
        F.round(((100 * F.sum(F.when(F.col("job_title") == "Analyst", 1).otherwise(0))) / F.count("*")), 1).alias("pct_analyst"),
    )
)

result = (
    df_departments.alias("d")
    .join(department_stats.alias("ds"), F.col("d.id") == F.col("ds.dept_id"), "left")
    .select(
        F.col("d.id"),
        F.col("d.dept_name"),
        F.col("ds.first_hire_date"),
        F.col("ds.pct_analyst"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("pct_analyst").desc())
)

sql: SELECT c.id, c.is_active, c.country, t.active_count, t.status_list FROM customers c JOIN (SELECT customer_id, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 END) AS active_count, SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(status)) AS status_list FROM subscriptions GROUP BY customer_id) t ON c.id = t.customer_id ORDER BY c.country DESC
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

customer_stats = (
    df_subscriptions
    .groupBy("customer_id")
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("status") == "ACTIVE", 1)).alias("active_count"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("status")).alias("status_list"),
    )
)

result = (
    df_customers.alias("c")
    .join(customer_stats.alias("t"), F.col("c.id") == F.col("t.customer_id"), "inner")
    .select(
        F.col("c.id"),
        F.col("c.is_active"),
        F.col("c.country"),
        F.col("t.active_count"),
        F.col("t.status_list"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("country").desc())

FROM employees e

WHERE d.budget <= 1716000
GROUP BY d.location;

SELECT

    DATE_FORMAT(signup_date, 'yyyy-MM') AS signup_month,

sql:
WITH SupplierTotals AS (
    SELECT supplier_id, SUM(CASE WHEN category = 'Home' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS home_count, SUM(CASE WHEN brand = 'Stark' THEN cost ELSE 0 END) AS stark_cost
    FROM products
    GROUP BY supplier_id
)
SELECT
    suppliers.id,
    suppliers.country,
    suppliers.rating,
    SupplierTotals.home_count,
    SupplierTotals.stark_cost

    df_products

)

        F.col("suppliers.id"),
        F.col("suppliers.country"),
        F.col("suppliers.rating"),
        F.col("SupplierTotals.home_count"),
        F.col("SupplierTotals.stark_cost"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("home_count").desc(), F.col("id").desc())
)

sql:
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT CASE WHEN amount >= 1460 THEN 'high' WHEN amount >= 230 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS amount_bucket, SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(method)) AS method_list, COUNT(CASE WHEN method = 'cash' THEN 1 END) AS cash_count
    FROM payments
    WHERE order_id IN (1, 2, 5, 12)
    GROUP BY CASE WHEN amount >= 1460 THEN 'high' WHEN amount >= 230 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END
) AS t
WHERE cash_count > 8
ORDER BY 3 DESC, amount_bucket
LIMIT 3;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_payments
    .filter(F.col("order_id").isin([1, 2, 5, 12]))
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("amount") >= 1460, "high").when(F.col("amount") >= 230, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("amount_bucket"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("method")).alias("method_list"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("method") == "cash", 1)).alias("cash_count"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("cash_count") > 8)
    .orderBy(F.col("cash_count").desc(), "amount_bucket")
    .limit(3)

SELECT
    DATE_FORMAT(last_restock, 'yyyy-MM') AS last_restock_month,
    CASE WHEN YEAR(last_restock) < 2024 THEN 'before_2024' WHEN YEAR(last_restock) = 2024 THEN '2024' ELSE 'after_2024' END AS last_restock_cohort,
    MAX(last_restock) AS latest_last_restock,
    MAX(last_restock) AS last_last_restock,
    MAX(quantity) - MIN(quantity) AS quantity_range
FROM inventory
WHERE product_id IN (2, 10) AND product_id IN (1, 5, 7)

        F.max("last_restock").alias("last_last_restock"),

sql:
SELECT
    order_id,
    ROUND(AVG(quantity), 2) AS avg_quantity,
    SUM(unit_price * quantity) AS revenue,
    COUNT(*) AS order_item_count
FROM order_items
WHERE product_id IS NOT NULL OR quantity < 6
GROUP BY order_id
HAVING COUNT(*) < 2;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_order_items
    .filter(F.col("product_id").isNotNull() | (F.col("quantity") < 6))
    .groupBy("order_id")
    .agg(
        F.round(F.avg("quantity"), 2).alias("avg_quantity"),
        F.sum((F.col("unit_price") * F.col("quantity"))).alias("revenue"),
        F.count("*").alias("order_item_count"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("order_item_count") < 2)
)

sql: SELECT MONTH(shipped_date) AS shipped_month, carrier, CASE WHEN YEAR(delivered_date) < 2024 THEN 'before_2024' WHEN YEAR(delivered_date) = 2024 THEN '2024' ELSE 'after_2024' END AS delivered_cohort, COUNT(DISTINCT cost) AS unique_orders, COUNT(*) AS row_count, MIN(shipped_date) AS first_shipped_date FROM shipments WHERE delivered_date > '2023-06-01' AND status IN ('RETURNED', 'LOST') GROUP BY MONTH(shipped_date), carrier, CASE WHEN YEAR(delivered_date) < 2024 THEN 'before_2024' WHEN YEAR(delivered_date) = 2024 THEN '2024' ELSE 'after_2024' END;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_shipments
    .filter((F.col("delivered_date") > "2023-06-01") & F.col("status").isin(["RETURNED", "LOST"]))
    .groupBy(
        F.month("shipped_date").alias("shipped_month"),
        "carrier",
        F.when(F.year("delivered_date") < 2024, "before_2024").when(F.year("delivered_date") == 2024, "2024").otherwise("after_2024").alias("delivered_cohort"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.countDistinct("cost").alias("unique_orders"),
        F.count("*").alias("row_count"),
        F.min("shipped_date").alias("first_shipped_date"),
    )
)

sql:
select
    d.location,
    case when d.budget >= 4183000 then 'high' when d.budget >= 708000 then 'mid' else 'low' end budget_bucket,
    count(*) cnt,
    count(distinct e.salary) unique_managers
from employees e
left join departments d on d.id = e.dept_id
group by d.location, case when d.budget >= 4183000 then 'high' when d.budget >= 708000 then 'mid' else 'low' end
having count(*) >= 5
order by location;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_employees.alias("e")
    .join(df_departments.alias("d"), F.col("d.id") == F.col("e.dept_id"), "left")
    .groupBy(
        F.col("d.location"),
        F.when(F.col("d.budget") >= 4183000, "high").when(F.col("d.budget") >= 708000, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("budget_bucket"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
        F.countDistinct(F.col("e.salary")).alias("unique_managers"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("cnt") >= 5)
    .orderBy("location")

sql:
SELECT
    CASE WHEN stores.sqft >= 15414 THEN 'high' WHEN stores.sqft >= 7568 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS sqft_bucket,
    stores.city,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN payments.status = 'REFUNDED' THEN 1 END) AS refunded_count,
    COUNT(*) AS total_count
FROM payments
LEFT OUTER JOIN orders ON payments.order_id = orders.id
LEFT OUTER JOIN stores ON orders.store_id = stores.id
GROUP BY CASE WHEN stores.sqft >= 15414 THEN 'high' WHEN stores.sqft >= 7568 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END, stores.city
ORDER BY sqft_bucket;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_payments.alias("payments")
    .join(df_orders.alias("orders"), F.col("payments.order_id") == F.col("orders.id"), "left")
    .join(df_stores.alias("stores"), F.col("orders.store_id") == F.col("stores.id"), "left")
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("stores.sqft") >= 15414, "high").when(F.col("stores.sqft") >= 7568, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("sqft_bucket"),
        F.col("stores.city"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("payments.status") == "REFUNDED", 1)).alias("refunded_count"),
        F.count("*").alias("total_count"),
    )
    .orderBy("sqft_bucket")
)

SELECT opened_cohort, region, west_sqft
FROM (
    SELECT CASE WHEN YEAR(opened_date) < 2024 THEN 'before_2024' WHEN YEAR(opened_date) = 2024 THEN '2024' ELSE 'after_2024' END AS opened_cohort, region, SUM(CASE WHEN region = 'West' THEN sqft ELSE 0 END) AS west_sqft
    FROM stores
    GROUP BY CASE WHEN YEAR(opened_date) < 2024 THEN 'before_2024' WHEN YEAR(opened_date) = 2024 THEN '2024' ELSE 'after_2024' END, region

),

sql:
WITH base AS (
    SELECT *, INITCAP(TRIM(dept_name)) AS dept_name_title
    FROM departments
    WHERE budget > 2925000
),
BudgetBucketSummary AS (
    SELECT CASE WHEN budget >= 3548000 THEN 'high' WHEN budget >= 1063000 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS budget_bucket, SUM(CASE WHEN dept_name = 'Legal' THEN budget ELSE 0 END) AS legal_budget
    FROM base
    GROUP BY CASE WHEN budget >= 3548000 THEN 'high' WHEN budget >= 1063000 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END
)
SELECT *
FROM BudgetBucketSummary
WHERE legal_budget >= 69
ORDER BY legal_budget DESC, budget_bucket
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

base = (
    df_departments
    .filter(F.col("budget") > 2925000)
    .withColumn("dept_name_title", F.initcap(F.trim("dept_name")))
)

budget_bucket_summary = (
    base
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("budget") >= 3548000, "high").when(F.col("budget") >= 1063000, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("budget_bucket"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("dept_name") == "Legal", F.col("budget")).otherwise(0)).alias("legal_budget"),
    )
)

result = (
    budget_bucket_summary
    .filter(F.col("legal_budget") >= 69)
    .orderBy(F.col("legal_budget").desc(), "budget_bucket")
)

sql:
SELECT
    o.status,
    CASE WHEN o.discount >= 0.35 THEN 'high' WHEN o.discount >= 0.18 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS discount_bucket,
    MIN(p.paid_at) AS first_paid_at,
    SUM(p.amount) AS total_amount
FROM payments p
INNER JOIN orders o ON o.id = p.order_id
GROUP BY o.status, CASE WHEN o.discount >= 0.35 THEN 'high' WHEN o.discount >= 0.18 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END
ORDER BY total_amount DESC, discount_bucket DESC, status
LIMIT 20;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

    df_payments.alias("p")

        F.col("o.status"),
        F.when(F.col("o.discount") >= 0.35, "high").when(F.col("o.discount") >= 0.18, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("discount_bucket"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.min(F.col("p.paid_at")).alias("first_paid_at"),
        F.sum(F.col("p.amount")).alias("total_amount"),
    )

)

    unit_price_range,
    max_unit_price
FROM (
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN unit_price >= 420 THEN 'high' WHEN unit_price >= 100 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS unit_price_bucket,
        product_id,
        MAX(unit_price) - MIN(unit_price) AS unit_price_range,
        MAX(unit_price) AS max_unit_price
    FROM order_items
    WHERE quantity < 4
    GROUP BY CASE WHEN unit_price >= 420 THEN 'high' WHEN unit_price >= 100 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END, product_id
) AS agg
WHERE max_unit_price < 300
ORDER BY unit_price_bucket, product_id
LIMIT 5;

        "product_id",
    )
    .agg(
        (F.max("unit_price") - F.min("unit_price")).alias("unit_price_range"),
        F.max("unit_price").alias("max_unit_price"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("max_unit_price") < 300)
    .select("unit_price_bucket", "product_id", "unit_price_range", "max_unit_price")

        CASE WHEN YEAR(last_restock) < 2024 THEN 'before_2024' WHEN YEAR(last_restock) = 2024 THEN '2024' ELSE 'after_2024' END AS last_restock_cohort,
        store_id,
        AVG(quantity) AS avg_quantity,

sql: WITH session_summary AS (SELECT session_id, MIN(duration_sec) AS min_duration_sec FROM web_events WHERE page IN ('/cart', '/home') GROUP BY session_id) SELECT s.id, s.customer_id, s.started_at, ss.min_duration_sec FROM sessions s LEFT JOIN session_summary ss ON s.id = ss.session_id ORDER BY s.id DESC;

)

    df_sessions.alias("s")

sql: SELECT CASE WHEN amount >= 3700 THEN 'high' WHEN amount >= 1500 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS amount_bucket, SUM(amount) AS total_amount, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(amount) DESC) AS rnk FROM transactions WHERE merchant IN ('Amazon', 'Lazada', '7-Eleven') GROUP BY CASE WHEN amount >= 3700 THEN 'high' WHEN amount >= 1500 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END ORDER BY 3 DESC, total_amount DESC;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.orderBy(F.col("total_amount").desc())

result = (
    df_transactions
    .filter(F.col("merchant").isin(["Amazon", "Lazada", "7-Eleven"]))

    from orders

order by id asc;

from pyspark.sql import functions as F

store_stats = (
    df_orders
    .groupBy("store_id")
    .agg(
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("channel") == "partner", 1).otherwise(0)).alias("partner_count"),
    )
)

sql:
SELECT
    ss.store_id,
    ss.product_id,
    MAX(i.quantity) AS max_quantity,
    ROUND(STDDEV(i.quantity), 2) AS stddev_quantity
FROM inventory i
LEFT OUTER JOIN store_sales ss ON i.store_id = ss.store_id AND i.product_id = ss.product_id
WHERE i.last_restock < '2023-07-01'
GROUP BY ss.store_id, ss.product_id
ORDER BY product_id DESC, store_id
LIMIT 10
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_inventory.alias("i")
    .join(df_store_sales.alias("ss"), (F.col("i.store_id") == F.col("ss.store_id")) & (F.col("i.product_id") == F.col("ss.product_id")), "left")
    .filter(F.col("i.last_restock") < "2023-07-01")
    .groupBy(F.col("ss.store_id"), F.col("ss.product_id"))
    .agg(
        F.max(F.col("i.quantity")).alias("max_quantity"),
        F.round(F.stddev(F.col("i.quantity")), 2).alias("stddev_quantity"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("product_id").desc(), "store_id")
    .limit(10)
)

sql:
WITH recent_employees AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM employees
    WHERE salary <= 78000
),
summary AS (
    SELECT CASE WHEN salary >= 162000 THEN 'high' WHEN salary >= 69000 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END salary_bucket, MAX(salary) max_salary, SUM(CASE WHEN job_title = 'Manager' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) manager_count
    FROM recent_employees
    GROUP BY CASE WHEN salary >= 162000 THEN 'high' WHEN salary >= 69000 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END
)
SELECT *
FROM summary
WHERE max_salary < 128000
ORDER BY manager_count DESC;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

recent_employees = df_employees.filter(F.col("salary") <= 78000)

summary = (
    recent_employees
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("salary") >= 162000, "high").when(F.col("salary") >= 69000, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("salary_bucket"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.max("salary").alias("max_salary"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("job_title") == "Manager", 1).otherwise(0)).alias("manager_count"),
    )
)

result = (
    summary
    .filter(F.col("max_salary") < 128000)
    .orderBy(F.col("manager_count").desc())
)

WITH product_totals AS (
    SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS num_order_items, SUM(unit_price * quantity) AS revenue
    FROM order_items
    GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT
    p.id,
    p.brand,
    pt.num_order_items,
    pt.revenue
FROM products p
JOIN product_totals pt ON p.id = pt.product_id

code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

product_totals = (
    df_order_items
    .groupBy("product_id")
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("num_order_items"),
        F.sum((F.col("unit_price") * F.col("quantity"))).alias("revenue"),
    )
)

result = (
    df_products.alias("p")
    .join(product_totals.alias("pt"), F.col("p.id") == F.col("pt.product_id"), "inner")
    .select(
        F.col("p.id"),
        F.col("p.brand"),
        F.col("pt.num_order_items"),
        F.col("pt.revenue"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("revenue").desc())
)

sql:
with filtered_order_items as (
    select *, greatest(quantity, unit_price) as greatest_quantity_unit_price
    from order_items
    where unit_price > 230 and order_id in (9, 23, 38)
),
greatest_quantity_unit_price_bucket_summary as (
    select case when greatest_quantity_unit_price >= 66 then 'high' when greatest_quantity_unit_price >= 36 then 'mid' else 'low' end as greatest_quantity_unit_price_bucket, avg(greatest_quantity_unit_price) as avg_greatest_quantity_unit_price
    from filtered_order_items
    group by case when greatest_quantity_unit_price >= 66 then 'high' when greatest_quantity_unit_price >= 36 then 'mid' else 'low' end
)
select *
from greatest_quantity_unit_price_bucket_summary
where avg_greatest_quantity_unit_price < 40
order by greatest_quantity_unit_price_bucket desc
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

filtered_order_items = (
    df_order_items
    .filter((F.col("unit_price") > 230) & F.col("order_id").isin([9, 23, 38]))
    .withColumn("greatest_quantity_unit_price", F.greatest("quantity", "unit_price"))
)

greatest_quantity_unit_price_bucket_summary = (
    filtered_order_items
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("greatest_quantity_unit_price") >= 66, "high").when(F.col("greatest_quantity_unit_price") >= 36, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("greatest_quantity_unit_price_bucket"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.avg("greatest_quantity_unit_price").alias("avg_greatest_quantity_unit_price"),
    )
)

result = (
    greatest_quantity_unit_price_bucket_summary
    .filter(F.col("avg_greatest_quantity_unit_price") < 40)
    .orderBy(F.col("greatest_quantity_unit_price_bucket").desc())
)

FROM orders o

code:

    df_orders.alias("o")
    .join(df_stores.alias("s"), F.col("s.id") == F.col("o.store_id"), "left")

        F.when(F.year(F.col("s.opened_date")) < 2024, "before_2024").when(F.year(F.col("s.opened_date")) == 2024, "2024").otherwise("after_2024").alias("opened_cohort"),

    MIN(last_restock) AS first_last_restock,
    AVG(quantity) AS avg_quantity,
    COUNT(quantity) AS quantity_count
FROM inventory
WHERE quantity < 96 AND last_restock BETWEEN '2023-06-24' AND '2025-08-01' AND quantity <= 115
GROUP BY 1
HAVING AVG(quantity) > 150
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_inventory
    .filter((F.col("quantity") < 96) & F.col("last_restock").between("2023-06-24", "2025-08-01") & (F.col("quantity") <= 115))
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.year("last_restock") < 2024, "before_2024").when(F.year("last_restock") == 2024, "2024").otherwise("after_2024").alias("last_restock_cohort"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.min("last_restock").alias("first_last_restock"),
        F.avg("quantity").alias("avg_quantity"),
        F.count("quantity").alias("quantity_count"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("avg_quantity") > 150)
)

sql: SELECT status, CASE WHEN YEAR(end_date) < 2024 THEN 'before_2024' WHEN YEAR(end_date) = 2024 THEN '2024' ELSE 'after_2024' END AS end_cohort, CASE WHEN monthly_fee >= 184 THEN 'high' WHEN monthly_fee >= 120 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS monthly_fee_bucket, ROUND((100 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'CANCELLED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_cancelled, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'PAUSED' THEN 1 END) AS paused_count FROM subscriptions WHERE MONTH(end_date) IN (4, 10, 12) AND customer_id = 15 AND monthly_fee <= 90 GROUP BY status, CASE WHEN YEAR(end_date) < 2024 THEN 'before_2024' WHEN YEAR(end_date) = 2024 THEN '2024' ELSE 'after_2024' END, CASE WHEN monthly_fee >= 184 THEN 'high' WHEN monthly_fee >= 120 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END ORDER BY monthly_fee_bucket, end_cohort;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_subscriptions
    .filter(F.month("end_date").isin([4, 10, 12]) & (F.col("customer_id") == 15) & (F.col("monthly_fee") <= 90))
    .groupBy(
        "status",
        F.when(F.year("end_date") < 2024, "before_2024").when(F.year("end_date") == 2024, "2024").otherwise("after_2024").alias("end_cohort"),
        F.when(F.col("monthly_fee") >= 184, "high").when(F.col("monthly_fee") >= 120, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("monthly_fee_bucket"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.round(((100 * F.sum(F.when(F.col("status") == "CANCELLED", 1).otherwise(0))) / F.count("*")), 1).alias("pct_cancelled"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("status") == "PAUSED", 1)).alias("paused_count"),
    )
    .orderBy("monthly_fee_bucket", "end_cohort")
)

    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_type ORDER BY txn_time, id) AS row_num
    FROM transactions
)
SELECT
    id,
    txn_type,
    txn_time,
    merchant
FROM ranked
WHERE row_num <= 3
ORDER BY txn_time ASC, id DESC;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("txn_type").orderBy("txn_time", "id")

result = (
    df_transactions
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") <= 3)
    .select("id", "txn_type", "txn_time", "merchant")
    .orderBy("txn_time", F.col("id").desc())
)

sql: WITH ValidAccounts AS (SELECT *, ROUND(balance, 0) AS balance_rounded FROM accounts WHERE NOT (status = 'CLOSED' AND opened_date <= '2024-12-23')), AccountsStats AS (SELECT MONTH(opened_date) AS opened_month, CASE WHEN account_type IN ('CHECKING', 'SAVINGS') THEN 'core' ELSE 'other' END AS account_type_group, MIN(balance_rounded) AS min_balance_rounded, ROUND(STDDEV(balance), 2) AS stddev_balance FROM ValidAccounts GROUP BY MONTH(opened_date), CASE WHEN account_type IN ('CHECKING', 'SAVINGS') THEN 'core' ELSE 'other' END) SELECT * FROM AccountsStats;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

valid_accounts = (
    df_accounts
    .filter(~((F.col("status") == "CLOSED") & (F.col("opened_date") <= "2024-12-23")))
    .withColumn("balance_rounded", F.round("balance", 0))
)

accounts_stats = (
    valid_accounts
    .groupBy(
        F.month("opened_date").alias("opened_month"),
        F.when(F.col("account_type").isin(["CHECKING", "SAVINGS"]), "core").otherwise("other").alias("account_type_group"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.min("balance_rounded").alias("min_balance_rounded"),
        F.round(F.stddev("balance"), 2).alias("stddev_balance"),
    )
)

result = accounts_stats

sql: SELECT p.supplier_id, CASE WHEN p.stock_qty >= 302 THEN 'high' WHEN p.stock_qty >= 81 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS stock_qty_bucket, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.revenue) AS unique_products FROM store_sales ss RIGHT JOIN products p ON ss.product_id = p.id JOIN suppliers s ON p.supplier_id = s.id GROUP BY p.supplier_id, CASE WHEN p.stock_qty >= 302 THEN 'high' WHEN p.stock_qty >= 81 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END ORDER BY stock_qty_bucket DESC, supplier_id LIMIT 3;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

    df_store_sales.alias("ss")
    .join(df_products.alias("p"), F.col("ss.product_id") == F.col("p.id"), "right")
    .join(df_suppliers.alias("s"), F.col("p.supplier_id") == F.col("s.id"), "inner")
    .groupBy(

    )

sql:
WITH filtered_store_sales AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE product_id IN (2, 7, 9)
),
summary AS (
    SELECT
        product_id,
        CASE WHEN units >= 39 THEN 'high' WHEN units >= 11 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS units_bucket,
        MAX(units) AS max_units,
        AVG(units) AS avg_units
    FROM filtered_store_sales
    GROUP BY product_id, CASE WHEN units >= 39 THEN 'high' WHEN units >= 11 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END
)
SELECT *
FROM summary
WHERE avg_units >= 33
ORDER BY product_id DESC;
code:

    filtered_store_sales
    .groupBy(
        "product_id",
        F.when(F.col("units") >= 39, "high").when(F.col("units") >= 11, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("units_bucket"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.max("units").alias("max_units"),
        F.avg("units").alias("avg_units"),
    )
)

result = (
    summary
    .filter(F.col("avg_units") >= 33)
    .orderBy(F.col("product_id").desc())
)

sql:
select is_flagged, case when amount >= 3300 then 'high' when amount >= 1500 then 'mid' else 'low' end as amount_bucket, round((100 * sum(case when txn_type = 'DEBIT' then 1 else 0 end)) / count(*), 1) as pct_debit
from transactions
where txn_time >= '2025-01-01' and txn_type = 'REFUND' and txn_type = 'FEE'
group by is_flagged, case when amount >= 3300 then 'high' when amount >= 1500 then 'mid' else 'low' end
having round((100 * sum(case when txn_type = 'DEBIT' then 1 else 0 end)) / count(*), 1) > 54
order by amount_bucket, is_flagged
limit 5
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_transactions
    .filter((F.col("txn_time") >= "2025-01-01") & (F.col("txn_type") == "REFUND") & (F.col("txn_type") == "FEE"))
    .groupBy(
        "is_flagged",
        F.when(F.col("amount") >= 3300, "high").when(F.col("amount") >= 1500, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("amount_bucket"),

sql: WITH ValidOrderItems AS (SELECT *, unit_price * quantity AS line_total FROM order_items WHERE NOT ((order_id IN (21, 28) AND quantity >= 5) OR unit_price <= 140)), order_items_stats AS (SELECT CASE WHEN unit_price >= 400 THEN 'high' WHEN unit_price >= 140 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS unit_price_bucket, CASE WHEN line_total >= 68 THEN 'high' WHEN line_total >= 23 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS line_total_bucket, SUM(unit_price * quantity) AS revenue FROM ValidOrderItems GROUP BY CASE WHEN unit_price >= 400 THEN 'high' WHEN unit_price >= 140 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END, CASE WHEN line_total >= 68 THEN 'high' WHEN line_total >= 23 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END) SELECT unit_price_bucket, revenue FROM order_items_stats WHERE revenue < 39 ORDER BY revenue;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

valid_order_items = (
    df_order_items
    .filter(~((F.col("order_id").isin([21, 28]) & (F.col("quantity") >= 5)) | (F.col("unit_price") <= 140)))
    .withColumn("line_total", (F.col("unit_price") * F.col("quantity")))
)

order_items_stats = (
    valid_order_items
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("unit_price") >= 400, "high").when(F.col("unit_price") >= 140, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("unit_price_bucket"),
        F.when(F.col("line_total") >= 68, "high").when(F.col("line_total") >= 23, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("line_total_bucket"),
    )
    .agg(F.sum((F.col("unit_price") * F.col("quantity"))).alias("revenue"))
)

result = (
    order_items_stats
    .filter(F.col("revenue") < 39)
    .select("unit_price_bucket", "revenue")
    .orderBy("revenue")
)

sql: SELECT CASE WHEN YEAR(shipped_date) < 2024 THEN 'before_2024' WHEN YEAR(shipped_date) = 2024 THEN '2024' ELSE 'after_2024' END AS shipped_cohort, status, SUM(CASE WHEN carrier = 'FedEx' THEN cost ELSE 0 END) AS fedex_cost, SUM(CASE WHEN carrier = 'Flash' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS flash_count, MAX(shipped_date) AS latest_shipped_date FROM shipments WHERE (cost < 65 AND delivered_date > '2023-12-23') OR shipped_date <= '2024-06-01' GROUP BY CASE WHEN YEAR(shipped_date) < 2024 THEN 'before_2024' WHEN YEAR(shipped_date) = 2024 THEN '2024' ELSE 'after_2024' END, status HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN carrier = 'Flash' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 76 ORDER BY latest_shipped_date, shipped_cohort, status LIMIT 20
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_shipments
    .filter(((F.col("cost") < 65) & (F.col("delivered_date") > "2023-12-23")) | (F.col("shipped_date") <= "2024-06-01"))
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.year("shipped_date") < 2024, "before_2024").when(F.year("shipped_date") == 2024, "2024").otherwise("after_2024").alias("shipped_cohort"),
        "status",
    )
    .agg(
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("carrier") == "FedEx", F.col("cost")).otherwise(0)).alias("fedex_cost"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("carrier") == "Flash", 1).otherwise(0)).alias("flash_count"),
        F.max("shipped_date").alias("latest_shipped_date"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("flash_count") > 76)
    .orderBy("latest_shipped_date", "shipped_cohort", "status")
    .limit(20)
)

sql: SELECT dept_name, SUM(budget) AS total_budget, COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(SUM(budget)) OVER (ORDER BY dept_name) AS cumulative_budget FROM departments WHERE location IS NULL GROUP BY dept_name ORDER BY cumulative_budget, cnt DESC

sql: with base as (select *, substring(supplier_name, 1, 2) as supplier_name_prefix from suppliers where rating > 2.9 and rating < 1.9), summary as (select case when rating >= 3.7 then 'high' when rating >= 1.5 then 'mid' else 'low' end as rating_bucket, sum(rating) as total_rating, count(case when city = 'Bangkok' then 1 end) as bangkok_count from base group by case when rating >= 3.7 then 'high' when rating >= 1.5 then 'mid' else 'low' end) select rating_bucket, total_rating, bangkok_count from summary where total_rating < 12 order by total_rating

WITH department_totals AS (
    SELECT dept_id, MIN(hire_date) AS first_hire_date, ROUND(STDDEV(salary), 2) AS stddev_salary
    FROM employees
    WHERE full_name IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY dept_id

from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_subscriptions
    .filter(F.col("customer_id").isin([32, 37, 38]) & (F.col("monthly_fee") < 80))
    .groupBy("plan", F.quarter("end_date").alias("end_quarter"))
    .agg(
        F.min("end_date").alias("first_end_date"),
        F.min("monthly_fee").alias("min_monthly_fee"),
        F.count("monthly_fee").alias("monthly_fee_count"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("monthly_fee_count") < 2)
    .drop("monthly_fee_count")
    .orderBy(F.col("first_end_date").desc())
)

sql: WITH src AS (SELECT * FROM order_items WHERE product_id IS NULL AND order_id IN (6, 25, 27, 40)), order_items_stats AS (SELECT CASE WHEN unit_price >= 430 THEN 'high' WHEN unit_price >= 60 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS unit_price_bucket, SUM(unit_price * quantity) AS revenue, SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity FROM src GROUP BY CASE WHEN unit_price >= 430 THEN 'high' WHEN unit_price >= 60 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END) SELECT * FROM order_items_stats ORDER BY 3;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

src = (
    df_order_items
    .filter(F.col("product_id").isNull() & F.col("order_id").isin([6, 25, 27, 40]))
)

order_items_stats = (
    src
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("unit_price") >= 430, "high").when(F.col("unit_price") >= 60, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("unit_price_bucket"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.sum((F.col("unit_price") * F.col("quantity"))).alias("revenue"),
        F.sum("quantity").alias("total_quantity"),
    )
)

result = order_items_stats.orderBy("total_quantity")

sql:
SELECT
    status,
    CONCAT_WS(', ', SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(channel))) channel_values,
    ROUND((100 * SUM(CASE WHEN channel = 'partner' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) / COUNT(*), 1) pct_partner,
    ROUND(AVG(shipping_fee), 2) avg_shipping_fee
FROM orders
WHERE customer_id = 36
GROUP BY status
ORDER BY avg_shipping_fee DESC, channel_values DESC
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_orders
    .filter(F.col("customer_id") == 36)
    .groupBy("status")
    .agg(
        F.concat_ws(", ", F.sort_array(F.collect_set("channel"))).alias("channel_values"),
        F.round(((100 * F.sum(F.when(F.col("channel") == "partner", 1).otherwise(0))) / F.count("*")), 1).alias("pct_partner"),
        F.round(F.avg("shipping_fee"), 2).alias("avg_shipping_fee"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("avg_shipping_fee").desc(), F.col("channel_values").desc())

sql:
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', order_date) AS order_month,
    channel,
    CASE WHEN YEAR(order_date) < 2024 THEN 'before_2024' WHEN YEAR(order_date) = 2024 THEN '2024' ELSE 'after_2024' END AS order_cohort,
    CONCAT_WS(', ', SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(status))) AS status_values,
    MAX(discount) - MIN(discount) AS discount_range
FROM orders
WHERE amount BETWEEN 740 AND 1030
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', order_date), channel, CASE WHEN YEAR(order_date) < 2024 THEN 'before_2024' WHEN YEAR(order_date) = 2024 THEN '2024' ELSE 'after_2024' END
HAVING discount_range >= 21
ORDER BY status_values
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_orders
    .filter(F.col("amount").between(740, 1030))
    .groupBy(
        F.date_trunc("MONTH", "order_date").alias("order_month"),
        "channel",
        F.when(F.year("order_date") < 2024, "before_2024").when(F.year("order_date") == 2024, "2024").otherwise("after_2024").alias("order_cohort"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.concat_ws(", ", F.sort_array(F.collect_set("status"))).alias("status_values"),
        (F.max("discount") - F.min("discount")).alias("discount_range"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("discount_range") >= 21)
    .orderBy("status_values")
)

FROM products p

SELECT CASE WHEN YEAR(o.order_date) < 2024 THEN 'before_2024' WHEN YEAR(o.order_date) = 2024 THEN '2024' ELSE 'after_2024' END AS order_cohort, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.unit_price) AS unique_orders
FROM order_items oi
LEFT JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
INNER JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY CASE WHEN YEAR(o.order_date) < 2024 THEN 'before_2024' WHEN YEAR(o.order_date) = 2024 THEN '2024' ELSE 'after_2024' END
ORDER BY unique_orders DESC, order_cohort DESC
LIMIT 50;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

    df_order_items.alias("oi")
    .join(df_orders.alias("o"), F.col("oi.order_id") == F.col("o.id"), "left")
    .join(df_products.alias("p"), F.col("oi.product_id") == F.col("p.id"), "inner")
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.year(F.col("o.order_date")) < 2024, "before_2024").when(F.year(F.col("o.order_date")) == 2024, "2024").otherwise("after_2024").alias("order_cohort"),
    )
    .agg(F.countDistinct(F.col("oi.unit_price")).alias("unique_orders"))
    .orderBy(F.col("unique_orders").desc(), F.col("order_cohort").desc())

    SUM(monthly_fee) AS total_monthly_fee,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(monthly_fee) DESC) AS rnk

    SUM(i.quantity) AS total_quantity,
    MAX(i.quantity) - MIN(i.quantity) AS quantity_range
FROM inventory i
INNER JOIN store_sales ss ON i.store_id = ss.store_id AND i.product_id = ss.product_id
WHERE i.store_id IN (2, 4, 5, 6)

    .filter(F.col("i.store_id").isin([2, 4, 5, 6]))
    .groupBy(
        F.col("ss.store_id"),
        F.quarter(F.col("ss.sale_date")).alias("sale_quarter"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.sum(F.col("i.quantity")).alias("total_quantity"),
        (F.max(F.col("i.quantity")) - F.min(F.col("i.quantity"))).alias("quantity_range"),
    )

INNER JOIN customers c ON a.customer_id = c.id

sql:
SELECT
    id,
    end_date,
    customer_id,
    start_date,
    monthly_fee,
    NTILE(3) OVER (ORDER BY end_date DESC, id) AS end_date_ntile,
    monthly_fee - LAG(monthly_fee, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY start_date, id) AS monthly_fee_change
FROM subscriptions
WHERE monthly_fee <= 180;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.orderBy(F.col("end_date").desc(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("start_date", "id")

result = (
    df_subscriptions
    .filter(F.col("monthly_fee") <= 180)
    .select(
        "id",
        "end_date",
        "customer_id",
        "start_date",
        "monthly_fee",
        F.ntile(3).over(w).alias("end_date_ntile"),
        (F.col("monthly_fee") - F.lag("monthly_fee", 2).over(w2)).alias("monthly_fee_change"),
    )
)

sql: select case when year(s.opened_date) < 2024 then 'before_2024' when year(s.opened_date) = 2024 then '2024' else 'after_2024' end as opened_cohort, sum(ss.revenue) as total_revenue, min(ss.units) as min_units from store_sales ss join products p on ss.product_id = p.id left join stores s on ss.store_id = s.id group by case when year(s.opened_date) < 2024 then 'before_2024' when year(s.opened_date) = 2024 then '2024' else 'after_2024' end order by 2 desc;

sql: with filtered_shipments as (select * from shipments where cost is null and status not in ('LOST', 'DELIVERED')), status_group_summary as (select case when status in ('LOST', 'RETURNED') then 'tier_1' else 'other' end as status_group, case when carrier in ('Flash', 'UPS') then 'core' else 'other' end as carrier_group, min(delivered_date) as min_delivered_date, sum(case when status = 'DELIVERED' then cost else 0 end) as delivered_cost from filtered_shipments group by case when status in ('LOST', 'RETURNED') then 'tier_1' else 'other' end, case when carrier in ('Flash', 'UPS') then 'core' else 'other' end) select status_group, carrier_group, min_delivered_date, delivered_cost from status_group_summary where delivered_cost >= 67;
